text.body:
(re15527.) (first leaf blank.)
(second leaf a blank.) (in b) vāgarthāvivasaṃpṛktau vāgarthapratipattaye| jagataḥ pitarau vande pārvatī parameśvarau|| (third leaf a) śāradātilakoktaprakāraṃ (...) kalpaṃ suhmaṇkavacam (???) (b) sauryapratiṣṭai, gaṇapati, skandan, durgai, dakṣiṇāmūrti, viṣṇu, dattan, mānuśapratiṣṭai, jñānadīkṣai, jñānapūjai, a(ā?)cāryābhiṣekam, saṃhārakramam, aṣṭabandhanavidhi, pradakṣiṇavidhi, rudrākṣavidhi, bhasmavidhi, prāsādavidhi (fourth leaf a and b blank.) [prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ] [prātaḥ śivadhyānam] hariḥ om (1a, 1st line) (damaged ………) kinnaragīyamānaṃ gaṅgādharasya tanayaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye| śrīdeveśaṃ (2nd line) śivāṃ vāṇīṃ gaṇeśaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ kurūn bhaktyā natvā caturthānāṃ śaivācārassamucyate| brāhme muhūrte utthāya uttarābhimukhaṃ bhūtvā tūṣṇīṃ vibhūtidhā(3rd line) raṇaṃ kṛtvā gurupādābjadvandvaṃ śirasi sañcitya yathādhikāraṃ śivaṃ dhyāyet| bhogāpavargadamityāgamavacanāt samayī hṛdayakamalamadhye vakṣya(4th line) māṇarudramūrtiṃ putrakassadāśivamūrtiṃ yogī bhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrayorbindunādau ca dhyātvā jñānī śivohamati bhāvayitvā śivaṃ kurūṃ natvā (5th line) stutvottiṣṭhet| nanu| brāhme muhūrtotthānādyācārastraivarṇikānāmeva vihitaḥ| atha kathaṃ caturthānāmācāraḥ kathyata iti cet sa(6th line) tyam| śūdrādi jātimuddhṛtya svāhāntenaiva mūlataḥ| ityāhutitrayam, paścāśchivaṃ prativadediti| āhārā(-)bhāvadoṣābhyāṃ yorubījaśarīrataḥ| śuddho dvijo (7th line) bhavatvājā(jñā) bhagavan parameśvareti kāmikādyāgamavacanāt| sat cchūdrāṇāṃ jātyuddharaṇasaṃskāravaśāt śivāgamoktānuṣṭhānaṃ vihitameva (1b, 1st line) (….. karmavidhiḥ) idamuttaratra vistareṇa pradarśa(-)i(yi?) ṣyāmaḥ| (visarjanam) atha grāmādbahirnirgatya āvaśyakāt pūrvaṃ śaucārthaṃ mṛttikāmaśarkarāmavālukāmavalmīkāma(...)mūlasthitā(-)(2nd line) matīrthamadhyasthitāmadagdhāmakuḍyasthāmamūṣikādyāghātām medinyā aṣṭāṅgulādadhasthitāḥ śuddhāṃ śaucaparyāptāṃ tṛṣṇīmādāya uddhṛtaśaucaviṣaye jalaṃ ca samāhṛtya (3rd line) śuddhabhūtale nidhāya valmīkaśilātalaśmaśānārāmadevālayasamīpauṣadhichakṣetra(-)dūrvākuśādiyuktadeśaṃ vihāya anyatra nirjane nirbhaye deśe (4th line) divā sandhyāsūdaṅmukho niśi dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ| akṣiroge andhakāre (...) saṃkaṭasthale yathāsaṃbhavamukhaḥ pracchanna(5th line) maulirmaunībhūtvā ayajñī yavabhūmimāstīrya diṅme caṇḍamārute tatra ṛju(-)kāyasamāhitacci(ci?)tto devavimānago brāhmaṇasomasūryāgnyādikaṃ sarvaṃ paśya (..........) nyastalocano vāmakaratarjanimadhyamā gṛhītaśiśnaḥ samalamūtre visṛjya anantaraṃ vāmakareṇa tatrasthā yajñīyatṛṇena kāṣṭhena loṣṭhena vā gudaṃ parimṛjya punarvā(..............)(6th line) (..................)raṃ gatvā jalādaratnimātraṃ vihāya śaucaṃ kuryāt| (śaucam) tadyathā prathamaṃ gandhalepakṣayārthaṃ (ācamanavidhiḥ) (2a, 1st line) (..................) śaucaṃ kṛtvā punaradraṣṭārtha(....)phalamātrāṃ mṛdaṃ dakṣiṇahaste nidāya vāmahaste datvā liṅgamekavāraṃ gude pañcavāraṃ mṛjjalaṃ vihāya (2nd line)
śaucaṃ kuryāt (.....) vāmahastaṃ daśavāreṇa punaḥ karau (3rd line) saptavāreṇa pādāvekaikavāreṇa ca mṛjjalābhyāṃ kṣālayet| idaṃ śaucaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ viraktānāṃ caturguṇam| evaṃ divi rātrāvardhaṃ rogiṇāṃ (4th line) tadardham, mahātīrtheṣūddhṛtya śaucaṃ kuryāt| tatra dhārāśaucaṃ na kartavyam, kartavyañculukodakaiḥ| śaucāvaśiṣṭāṃ mṛccheṣaṃ jalena śodhayet| tata (5th line)
utthāya dhṛtakaupīno vāmapārśve dvādaśavāraṃ gaṇḍūṣayitvā śirapracchādanamapanīya anyasmindeśe amantrakamekavāraṃ samantrakamekavāraṃ śuddhācamanadvayaṃ (6th line) kuryāt| (ācamanam) tadyathā pūrvābhimukho vā uttarābhimukho vā kukkuṭāsano jānumadhyakaradvayo bhūtvā antyajātyākhātasevitataṭākodakaṃ go pipāsopa(7th line) śamanāparyāptapalvalodakamasṛbhūtajalaṃ kaṣāyodakamuktodakaṃ vā sa(..)yuktajalaṃ tāmasarājasajalāni ca vihāya śuddhajalaṃ gokarṇavat (2b, 1st line)
kṛtapāṇinā gṛhītatvāmuktāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikena māṣamagnajalaṃ phenabṛkbṛdādiharitamālokya pūrvavat gokarṇākāreṇa brahmatīrthena niśśabdaṃ triḥ pibet (2nd line) uddhṛtajalañcedvastrapūtajalaṃ pibediti vacanāt|vastreṇa saṃśoddhya pātraṃ bhūmau nidhāya vāmahastena pātraṃ sācīkṛtya dakṣiṇahaste (3rd line) ninīya pūrvavat pibet| śaucapādaprakṣālanaśeṣeṇa jalena nācamet jalāntarāsambhave tajjalaṃ bhūmau kiñcinninīya pātraṃ (4th line)
bhūmau nidhāya nirīkṣaṇādibhiḥ saṃskṛtvācamet| śuddhācamanakāle hāsānyāvalokanavacanakaṇḍūyanādīni varjayet| śayyāsana(5th line) pādukāsthaḥ uṣṇīṣī dakṣiṇaskandhasthavastrovānācāmet| āvaśyakakāladhṛtadravyasahita evācāmet| atha śiraḥ pādau ca (6th line)
prokṣya dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamūlena dakṣiṇapārśvoṣṭhau dviḥ parimṛjya| madhyamāṅgulitrayairāsyamayaḥ sakṛt parimṛjya vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa nāsikākṣikarṇanābhiśca (7th line) (......) bāhūndakṣiṇa(-)vāmakrameṇa jalaṃ saṃspṛśya (..)ścāt samantrācamanamācaret| tadyathā pūrvoktaprakāreṇa jalaṃ gṛhītvā ātmatatvaśuddhyarthaṃ pūrvaṃ (3a, 1st line)
hrasvapraṇa (...) hām ātmatatvāya svadheti pṛthak| vidyātatvaśuddhyarthaṃ hīṃ vidyātatvāya svadheti dvitīyam| śivatatvaśuddhyarthaṃ hūṃ śivatatvāya svadheti (2nd line) tṛtīyaṃ pibet| evaṃ vakṣyamāṇeṣvapi mantreṣu tatrāpi nādarahita iti vacanāt hrasvapraṇavapūrvakatvaṃ vijñeyam| tata(-)śśivamantreṇa mūrdhānaṃ pādau (3rd line) ca prokṣya dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhamūlena namontaṃ hṛdayena auṣṭhau dviḥ parimṛjya madhyamāṃgulitrayeṇa bhāratī(-)prītyarthaṃ tat bījākṣareṇa (4th line) āsyamadhaḥ parimṛjya aṃguṣṭhe īśvarasya sthitatvāt anāmikāgre amṛtakalāyāsthitatvāt tattat tattat sthānaśuddhyarthaṃ (5th line) tattadadhiṣṭhānadevatātṛptyarthaṃ ca aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ prāṇanetraśrotranābhihṛdayamūrdhabāhūn krameṇa spṛśet| oṣṭhadvayasparśane praṇavam (6th line) āsyasparśena bhāratī| nāsikāsparśena prāṇaḥ| cakṣudvayasparśena candrasūryau, śrotradvayasparśena digdevatā| nābhisparśena brahmā| hṛdayasparśena (7th line) layakartā| śirasparśena viṣṇuḥ| (.....) sparśenāśvinau cetyetā devatāstṛptā bhavanti| taduktaṃ parākhye anāmayāṃ ca saṃsparśaḥ kartavyoṃ(3b, 1st line) guṣṭha (...) tayā| bhavedīśaḥ sacāṅguṣṭho nāma nāmāmṛtā kalā| tayāmṛtātmanā devatā tṛptāstvanāmayā| bhavanti tatkriyākartuḥ kriyābhāvopabrahmakāḥ| (2nd line)
bhāratī rasanāgrasthā praṇavaścoṣṭhasaṃpuṭe| nāsāpuṭadvaye pārāṇāścakṣuṣo śaśibhāskarau| śrotrayośca diśassarvā nābhau brahmā layo hṛdi| (3rd line)
śuddhyarthaṃ mastake viṣṇura(....)yoraśvinau sthitau|| iti| jalatīreṣu jale vāmapādaṃ tīre dakṣiṇapādaṃ ca nidhāya ācamanaṃ kuryāt| ityācamanavidhiḥ|(4th line) atha dantadhāvanam| śubhrastu pratipat ṣaṣṭhī navamī ekādaśī paurṇamāsyamāvāsyāsu na kuryāt| udayānantaramapi na kuryāt| (5th line) amāvāsyaikādaśī paitṛkadivasāni vinā itarāsu niṣiddhatithiṣu parṇaistṛṇairvā kuryāt| etāsu tithiṣvapādvādaśagaṇḍūṣairvā śucirbhavati| (6th line) viraktaistu pratipadādi sarvāsutithiṣvabhojanottaraṃ ca dantadhāvanaṃ kartavyam| taduktam cintyaviśvasādākhye (–) pratipatparvaṣaṣṭhīṣu navamī darśayorapi| (7th line) mumukṣośca viśeṣeṇa nityaṃ vai dantadhāvanam|| iti| gṛhasthaistvāmṛja (...) pāmārgakakubhādyaniṣiddhakṣīravṛkṣotthaṃ kaniṣṭhāṃgulipariṇāhamaṣṭāṃgulipramāṇaṃ (4a, 1st line) śuddhamārdra(-)parvakaṃ satvajamṛjumasamaśchedyaṃ namontaṃ hṛdayenābhimantritadantakāṣṭhaṃ dantairmṛdulaṃ kṛtvā pūrvābhimukhaḥ san rājadantamārabhya savya(-)krameṇāntarbahiśca (2nd line) dantamāṃsamapāryan śanaiśśanaiśśodhayitvā prakṣāḻya tatkāṣṭhaṃ vāmapārśve parityajya gaṇḍūṣayitvā hastau prakṣāḻya tajjātīyakāṣṭhena vā (......) akṣarābhimantritena (3rd line) jihvālekhanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktavidhānena gaṇḍūṣayet| viraktastu karañjaciribilvakhadirārjunaśirīṣodbhavāni (4th line) pūrvoktalakṣaṇāni śiṣyāhṛtāni dantakāṣṭhāni saṃgṛhya pūrvokta(-)vidhānena dantaśodhanaṃ kuryāt| śiṣyābhāve svayaṃ patitaparṇaiḥ kuryāt| (5th line) dhavadhātriśigrūniṃ bakatakairaṇḍatintriṇījapāpiśāca nāma vṛkṣasaṃbhavāṃśca nāḻikerodbhavaṃ ca lohanirmitabhasmamṛdvastrāṃgulyādīn varjayet| (*)||snānavidhiḥ|| (*)(6th line) atha snānavidhirucyate| gṛhasthānāṃ mṛttikāsnānam keśadhāriṇāmāmalakasnānam| viraktānāṃ mṛttikāsnānaṃ nityameva śuddhadeśe (7th line) aṣṭāṃgulipramāṇādadhaḥ astreṇa khātvā ha hṛdayenāhṛtya tenaivāvaṭaṃ pūrya tīrthatīre namontaśirasā nikṣipya astreṇa śodhayitvā śikhayā tṛṇādī(4b, 1st line) nuddhṛtya kavacena tridhā vibhajya ācamya prāṇāyāmapurassaraṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇa ūrau dakṣiṇottarau karau kṛtvā śivaśiva śambhorājñāpravartamānasya (2nd line) adyabrahmaṇo dvitīyaparārdhe śveta(-)varāhakalpe vaivasvatamanvantare kaliyuge prathame pāde jambūdvīpe bhāratavarṣe bharatakhaṇḍe merordakṣiṇapārśve asmin vartamāne (3rd line) vyavahārike amukasaṃvatsare amukāyane amukartau amukamāse amukapakṣe amukavāranakṣatrayogakaraṇayuktāyāmasyāṃ puṇyatithau asmākaṃ (4th line) sakuḍumbānāṃ samastapāpakṣayadvārā caturvidhapuruṣārthasidhyartham asmin tīrthe snānaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya utthāya| atikrūramahākā(5th line) yakalpāntadahanopamam| bhairavāya namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi| iti kṣetrapālaṃ namaskṛtya labdhvānujñaḥ śivaṃ guruṃ namaskṛtya tatra śreṣṭhānapyabhivādya (6th line) taṭākapuṣkaraṇīṣu pañcapiṇḍānuddhṛtya tīre visṛjya trilokapāvani śreṣṭhaśivacūḍānivāsini| gaṃgādevi namastubhyaṃ jalesmin saṃnidhiṃ kuru|| iti gaṅgābhavānīṃ (7th line) prārthya kaṭiveṣṭidaśāṃ kaṭisūtre vāmapārśve baddhvā ekadā mṛdā nābhyādivā(pā)daparyantam ālipya kṣālayet| madhyamāṃśāṃ mṛdamādāya saptavāramastreṇā(5a, 1st line) bhimantrya kāyikakalmaṣaśāntaye mastakādi(-)pādāntamanulipya indriyakalmaṣaśāntaye akṣāṇi niruddhya | vācikapāpaśāntaye prāsādamuccārya mānasakalmaṣaśāntaye (2nd line) pāṇān saṃyamya hṛdaye kālāgnisamaprabhaṃ śivāstraṃ smarannidamavagāhya yāvat śakyamāsīt| tato jalāntarādutthāyācamya nyāsaṃ kṛtvā hṛdaye pradīptāstrarū(3rd line) piṇīṃ sandhyāṃ dhyātvā astragāyatryā śirastriḥ| prokṣya tenaivārghyatrayaṃ kṛtvā daśa(-) vāramastragāyatrīṃ japet| śivāstrāyavidmahe (4th line) kālānalāya dhīmahi tannaśśastrapracodayāt| iti| tataḥ jalāduttīrya tṛtīyāṃśamṛdamādāya nābhidaghnajā(ja)le vā yathāsaṃbhavajale vā prātaḥ (5th line) pūrvābhimukho madhyāhne uttarābhimukhaḥ sāyāhne paścimābhimukho nadīṣu pravāhābhimukho bhūtvā hastasthitāṃ mṛdaṃ jalena secayitvā (6th line) pūrvayāmyasaumyakrameṇa tridhā vibhajya pūrvavat bhāgaṃ huṃphaṭantāstreṇa saptavāramabhimantrya dakṣiṇamṛdbhāgaṃ hṛdayādi caturaṅgamantreṇa vā sadyojātādi (7th line) pañcabra(hmama)ntreṇa vā ekavāramabhimantrya saumyadigbhāgadaśavāramabhimantryātha pūrvādimṛdbhāgaṃ saṃhāramudrayā ādāya digvighnopa(....) (5b, 1st line) (....)streṇa pūrvādidaśadikṣu nārācamudrayā kṣipet| tatassaumyadik mṛdbhāgārdhamādāya jalagatasarvadoṣāpanodārthaṃ jale nikṣipya aparāṃ (2nd line) śivatīrthasiddhyarthaṃ bāhuparibhrameṇa mūlena samantāt nikṣipet| tataḥ aṅkuśamudrayā bindu(-) sthānāt parāśaktiparisṛtā mṛtamākṛṣya udbhavamudrayā namontahṛdaye (3rd line) jale saṃsthāpyāvakuṇṭhya(ṇṭhyā)mṛtīkuryāt| tataḥ yāmyadigmṛdamādāya kāyikapāpaśāntaye aṅgamantreṇa vā pañcabrahmamantreṇa vā (4th line) mastakādi pādāntaṃ sarvāṅgamālipya aṅguṣṭhatarjanimadhyamābhiḥ yathākramaṃ ṣaṇmukhamudrayā śrotranetranāsike ca pidhāya hṛdayakamale (5th line) śivaṃ dhyātvā prāsādamanusmaran prāṇān saṃyamya śivatīrthe samyak nimajya yāvatśakyaṃ tāvat snāyāt| tata utthāya candrārkarūpa(-) vāmadakṣiṇa(6th line) hastau śaktiśivau bhāvayitvā kumbhamudrayā vauṣaḍantasaṃhitāyā mūrdhānaṃ mahurmuhurabhiṣiñcet| tataḥ ātmasaṃrakṣaṇāya humphaḍantāstreṇa ambhaṃ (7th line) paritaḥ pariṣicyācamya nyāsaṃ kṛtvā devarṣipitṝn saṃgraheṇa tarpayitvā saṃhāramudrayā namontahṛdayena (...........) jalamādāyāñjalitrayaṃ datvā (6a, 1st line) (…) vāmapādaṃ tīre dakṣiṇapādaṃ ca nikṣipyācamet| viraktastu bhūtapīḍāṃ na kurvīta puṣpāṇāṃ ca na kṛntanamityādivacanāt śiṣyeṇa parvatānnadītīrāt puṇyakṣetrāt (2nd line) aśvatthamūlāt śuddhasthalādvā ānītāṃ mṛdaṃ pūrvoktavidhānena saṃhārakrameṇa pādādimastakāntamālipya pitṛtarpaṇaṃ vinā (3rd line) sarvaṃ kuryāt| śiṣyābhāve nadyādiṣvapīḍayan uparisthāṃ mṛdaṃ svayamādāya snāyāt| grāmādbahirnadyādiṣu gatvā snātumaśaktaścet gṛhe vā (4th line) maṭhe vā śītena taptena jalena vā pūrvokta(-)vidhinā snāyāt| kūpajalasnānādvāpi(-)jalasnānam, tasmāt taṭākasnānam| tato nadīsnānam tasmāt (5th line) gaṅgādimahānadī śivālayasamīpapuṣkariṇī gurupādodakasnānamuttarottaramadhikaphalaṃ bhavet| atha gātralagnaṃ dhautānārdravastreṇa (6th line)
dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ kukkuṭāsanaḥ san mārjayitvā aśchidraṃ svanitambapramāṇaṃ śubhrakaupīnaṃ namontavāmena pāyudeśasaṃbandhidaśādvayaṃ dhṛtvā upari (7th line) śveta(-) vastrameva veṣṭayet| raktapītanīlakāṣāyādi na dhārayet| taddhāraṇe devaputṛkāryādiṣvanarha eva| gṛhasthaḥ kāṣāyadhāri cet taddarśane sūryāvalo(6b, 1st line) kanaṃ kartavyam| gṛhasthānāṃ kaupīnadhāraṇaniṣedhastu traivarṇikānāmeva| viraktastu uktalakṣaṇakaupīnaṃ kāṣāyaṃ daśādvayaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā dhārayet| tadupari (2nd line) kāṣāyakaṭiveṣṭiṃ dhṛtvācāmet| tataḥ viraktastu bhasmasnānaṃ kuryāt| vāruṇe snānottaraṃ bhasmasnānādhikārī bhavati| vāruṇasnānāśaktaścet tatsthāne bhasmasnānameva kartavyam| (3rd line) śiva(-)bhāvanāsiddhayogī cet vāruṇasnānamutsṛjya āgneyasnānaṃ vā samācaret| taduktaṃ mataṅge (–) evaṃ sakṛdyathāśaktisnātombhasi (*)dine dine |(*) (4th line) bhasmasnāne adhikārī syāt nānyathā munipuṃgavāḥ|| eṣa vidhiḥ kriyāpādinam| bhūyo bhūyombhasā snānaṃ sevyamānasya rukbhavet| (5th line)

svacchandabhairave (–) yasyāvalokamātreṇa parānando'pi jāyate| guruṃ tameva vṛṇuyāt nāparaṃ matimān (*)naraḥ||(*) (71b, 1st line)
ajite (–) dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kartā yasya gurusmṛtaḥ| vilayantyanta(dha)kārastu yathā sūryasya sannidhau|| gurornirīkṣaṇādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate| (2nd line) guru sparśati hastena yaṃ yaṃ paśyati cakṣūṣā|| śivaṃ bhavati tatsarvaṃ śivādeva prasādataḥ| na lipyate malenaiva patma(dma)patramivāmbhasā|| tasmāt guruḥ śivaprokto guruśa(*)ktirmanonmanī|(*) (3rd line) dīkṣāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu pāpināṃ kṛtavānapi|| śivajñānaṃ hṛtga(dga)taṃ cet jñānārthaṃ taṃ samāśrayet| jñānahīnaṃ guruṃ prāpya kuto mūrtiravāpyate|| śilā(*)śilāśritā cāpi yathā pāraṃ na gacchati|(*) (4th line) tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saṃśrayet jñānapāragam|
sūtasaṃhitāyām (–) yo vidyāsantati jñānavihīno deśiko (*)bhavet|(*) (5th line) sa ghoraṃ yāti narakaṃ nāsti sandehakāraṇam|| yo vidyāsantati jñānahīgīno deśiko bhavet| sa nabhobhakṣaṇenaiva kṣadvyādhiṃ na niva(*)rtate||(*) (6th line) yo vidyāsantati jñānavihīno deśiko bhavet| sa vinaiva tilāt tailaṃ labhate sikatāsu ca|| siddhābodhe (–) śāstrajñānavihīnaśca varṇā(*)śramavihīnakaḥ|(*) (7th line) kāmādyaṣṭavikāreṇa yeṣaṇātrayasaṃbhavaḥ|| duśśīlo durmano vṛttiḥ durguṇo duṣpratigrahaḥ| mantratantrādhikāreṇa yogajñānavihī(*)nakaḥ||(*) (8th line) samayādipañcadīkṣāntaṃ na kuryāduktalakṣaṇāt| pūjālaṅkāraḍambhena naṭanaiḥ kṣuddhalakṣaṇaiḥ|| kṣutbā(dbā)dhaśamanārthena guru kurvanviśeṣataḥ| etādṛśagurau (*)dīkṣā śiṣyāṇāṃ narakāya hi||(*) (9th line) ka(...)syāndhena mārgo hi naiva sandṛśyate kvacit| tasmāt santaṃ guruṃ prāpya upatiṣṭheta lakṣaṇāt|| tataḥ uktalakṣaṇasaṃpanna ācārya(*)svāśritān|(*) (10th line) śiṣyānyekavatsaramātraṃ vā parīkṣya vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇayuktān śiṣyān yathādhikāraṃ dīkṣayet|
|| śiṣyalakṣaṇam || raurave (–) atatvavidabhakteṣu dīkṣāṃ kuryādya(*)thā guruḥ|(*) (72a, 1st line) dīkṣitānaśivaṃ yānti guru nīrayago bhavet||
sūtasaṃhitāyām (–) mūrkhaśiṣyopadeśena vidyāgarveṇa suvratāḥ| gurudroheṇa sarvajño'pyandhakūpe (*)patatyasau||(*) (2nd line) tasmāt saṃvatsaraṃ śiṣyaḥ parīkṣyo kṛtrimaḥ punaḥ|
anyatra ca (–) guruśca svāśritān śiṣyān varṣamekaṃ parīkṣayet| uttamāṃścādhame kṛtye nīcānuttamakarmasu|| (3rd line) ākṛṣṭastāḍitā vāpi na viṣādaṃ prayānti ye| te yogyāḥ saṃgatāḥ śūrāḥ śivasaṃskārakarmaṇi|| caturvarṇeṣṭhī sañjātaiḥ śāstrajñānanirūpakaiḥ| bhaktijñānavirageṇa bu(*)ddhimānnītimān sadā||(*) (4th line) puruṣārthaḥ prakartā ca sadā nirṇayabuddhimān| śuśrūṣāyāṃ ca kuśalo gurukārye prayatnataḥ|| santataṃ guruśuśrūṣāvacollaṅghanabhīrukaḥ| etat (*)lakṣaṇasambaddhaḥ saścityāṇāṃ ca lakṣaṇam||(*) (5th line)
parākhye (–) amadyapāstu ye rudrāḥ śaucācārakriyādarāḥ| śivabhaktāśca ye teṣāṃ dīkṣā kāryānyathā na hi||(6th line) sarveṣāmeva śiṣyāṇāmadhikaṃ satgu(dgu)ṇaṃ śṛṇu| bhaktirviśvāsamadrohaṃ gurvājñāpālanasthitiḥ|| śraddhā śāntiḥ kṣamā satyaṃ tathāśaucaṃ tapaśrutam| kṛtajñatā (*)dvādaśakaṃ yasya śiṣyasya vidyate||(*) (7th line) sa śiṣyāṇāṃ pradhānaśca nānye tena pradhānakāḥ| etaduktalakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣadīkṣāviṣayam| samayena vicārayediti vacanāt| (8th line) mahāpātakādidoṣarahitān sa śūdrāṃ dīkṣayet| (śaktinipātaḥ) nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ śaktinipātayuktasyaivādhikārāt mandamandataratīvratarān śaktinipātān| śiṣyeṣu parīkṣyaiva (9th line) dīkṣayitvā tadanuguṇena parāparamuktiṣu yojayet| śaktinipāto nāma āṇavamalaśakteḥ pātanam ātmani īśvaraśakterabhivyaktaśca īśvaraśakteryāvadyāvadabhivyaktistāvat (10th line) tāvadāṇavamalaśakternivṛttiḥ| taduktaṃ mṛgendre (–) tamaśśaktyadhikārasya nivṛttau tatparicyutau| vyanakti duṣkriyānandaṃ jagatba(dba)ndhuraṇe śiva|| parākhye ca (–) (72b, 1st line) svalpe'bhivyajyate svalpaṃ mahat mahati tatsthitam| yādṛk tādṛk bhavet tasya pradīpastimire yathā|| svāyambhuve ca (–) śivecchayā parānandā śaiva (*)śaivārthadāyikā|(*) (2nd line) sā śaktipatatyādyā puṃso janmanyapaścime|| tannipātāt kṣaratyasya malaṃ saṃsārakāraṇam| kṣīṇe tasmin yathā sā syāt paraṃ niśreyasaṃ prati||(3rd line) sa deśikamanuprāpya dīkṣāvicchinnabandhanaḥ| prayāti śivasāyujyanirmale nirupadravaḥ|| anena kramayogena parāṃ kevalatāṃ gataḥ| anādyaśuddhiśūnyatvāt prāpnoti na bhavā(*)ntaram||(*) (4th line)
mataṅge ca (–) yāvat sonmīlanīśakti śivarāgeṇa saṃyutā| nipatyatitejiṣṭhā nityānugrahaśālinī|| tannipātācca tasyetthamajñasyāpyabhilāṣiṇaḥ|(5th line) buddhirutpadyantaka syāt vivekenātmavartinā|| vivekino viraktasya jijñāsā copajāyate| jijñāsopetacaitanyaṃ paśuṃ saṃsārasāgarāt|| ji(*)ghrakṣayā yunaktyenaṃ yuktaṃ prerayitā prabhuḥ|(*) (6th line) preraṇe prerakaśrīmān dvayorapi samantrarāṭ|| anugrāhyasya vinaye tathānugrahakasya ca| kāruṇye tva(*)nayoryasmāt tayoryogaḥ sudurlabham|| iti (*) (7th line)
ātmani īśvaraśakteḥ svalpābhivyaktau mandataraśchaktinipātataḥ| tadānīmātmanaḥ saṃsāranivṛttimīśvaro yayā śaktyā karoti sā śakti hi (8 th line) vṛttiṃ nāma| saiva ca nivṛttīśvarasthānam| tatpatiśca nivṛttīśaḥ pūrvasmādadhikābhivyaktau mandataraśchaktinipātaḥ| tarap pratyayasya nyūnādhikavacanatvāt| atra tu adhikavācaka (9th line) eva tadānivṛttasya punaḥ pravṛttirabhitatvena yathāśaktyā pratiṣṭhāpayati| sā pratiṣṭhā śaktiḥ saiva ca pratiṣṭheśvarasthānam| tatprati pratiṣṭheśvaraḥ| tato'pyadhikābhivyaktau (10th line) tīvraśaktinipātaḥ| tadānīṃ yathāśaktyā viṣayagocarapaśujñānaṃ mocayitvā śivajñānaṃ prakāśayati| sā śaktirvidyā saiva ca vidyeśvarasthānaṃ tatpatirvidyeśvaraḥ| (73a, 1st line) tataḥ śivajñānapūrṇābhivyaktau tīvratā śaktinipātaḥ| tadānīṃ yayā śaktyā tāpatrayādisarvabandhaṃ mocayitvā parāṃ śāntiṃ dadāti sā (2nd line) śaktiḥ śāntiḥ| saiva ca śāntīśvarasthānaṃ tatpatiḥ śāntīśaḥ|
taduktaṃ mṛgendre (–) nivartayati bhūtāni yayā sāsya nirvartakā| nivṛttiriti tatsthānaṃ tatreśo'pi nivṛ(*)ttimān|(*) (3rd line) nivṛttasya gatirbhūyo yāsya pracyavalakṣaṇā|| nikṣipyate pratiṣṭhā sā sthānaṃ tadvāṃśca tat patiḥ| kātyaktātmagamyaviṣayaṃ yayā jñānaṃ dadātyaṇoḥ|| sā(*) vidyāsthānamapyasya vidyeśaśca tadīśvaraḥ|(*) (4th line) sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ yayāsya kurute haraḥ|| sā śānti saptapadaṃ ceti tat kurvan so'pi śāntimān| iti
śaktinipātayu(5th line) ktasya cihnānyāha mṛgendre (–) yeṣāṃ śarīriṇāṃ śakti patatyanivṛttaye teṣām| talliṅgamautsukyamuktau dve(...)ṣo bhavasthitau|| bhaktiśca śivabhakte(*)ṣu śraddhā tacchāsake vidhau|(*) (6th line)
anyatra ca (-) dehapātastathā kampaḥ paramānandaharṣaṇe| dehe romāñca ityetat śaktipātasya lakṣaṇam|| pauṣkare (–) ka(*)dā drakṣyāmi deveśaṃ mokṣye'haṃ bandhataḥ kadā|(*) (7th line) ko vā darśayitā śambhoḥ ri(i)ti sañjāyate matiḥ|| evaṃ śiṣyasya cihneḥ śaktinipātaṃ jñātvā gṛhasthe (8th line) bubhukṣumeva dīkṣayet| viraktastu bubhukṣumumukṣuśca dīkṣayet| taduktam acintyaviśvasādākhye (–) naiṣṭhiko naiṣṭhikāṃścaiva gṛhasthān dīkṣayetkramāt| bhautikastu (*)gṛhasthatāṃśca nānyat dīkṣāṃ samācaret||(*) (9th line) iti| (dīkṣākālanirṇayaḥ) dīkṣāyāḥ kālanirmayamāha (–) makuṭe uttarāyaṇakāle tu śuklapakṣe śubhe dine| samuhūrte sulagne ca dīkṣāk (*)samācaret||(*) (10th line) kālottare (–) śaradvasantayoryogo dīkṣākarmavidhau varaḥ| tayorasambhave varṣā vinānyatrāpi śasyate|| dīkṣāyāmabhiṣeke ca tathā mantraparigra(*)he|(*) (73b, 1st line) vratagrahaṇamokṣe ca dravyalābhena karmasu|| kārtikyāṃ caiva vaiśākhyāṃ svargānorapi darśane| dinacchidrādiyuktāśca yāścānyāstithayaḥ smṛtaḥ|| candrasū(*)ryoparāge tu śaḍaśīti mukheṣu ca|(*) (2nd line) grahanakṣatrayogeṣu viṣuveṣūtsave'pi ca|| ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yāgasarvārthasiddhidaḥ| caturthī navamī ṣa(*)ṣṭhīmaṣaṣṭhīṃ ca caturdaśīm||(*) (3rd line) paurṇamāsyāṃ vinā śeṣā hitāḥ sarve bubhukṣuṣu| ādityaṃ maṅgaḻaṃ saurīṃ tyaktvā vārāṇi bhūtaye|| trīṇyuttarāṇi rohiṇyāṃ (*)puṣyarkṣamṛgaśīrṣakam|(*) (4th line) hastaṃ svātiranūrādhāmakhāmūlaṃ ca revatīm|| abhijicchravaṇaṃ ceti śivayāge caturdaśa| yogāśca prītirāyuṣmān saubhāgyaśobhanaśśu(*)bham||(*) (5th line) sukarmaśca dhṛtirviddhi (...)vasiddhiśca harṣaṇaḥ| varīyān sa śivaḥ siddho brāhma aindraśca ṣoḍaśa|| kāraṇāni viṣṭivyatiriktāni śubhāni (...)| yāni janindyāni sa(*)rvāṇi praśastāni vimuktaye||(*) (6th line) uktakāle puṇyakṣetre puṇyatīrthasamīpe maṭhe pūrvanirmitamaṇḍape vā dīkṣīṃ kuryāt|
||maṇḍapalakṣaṇam|| atha maṇḍapala(7th line) kṣaṇamāha (–) suprabhede (–) uttamaṃ navahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ saptahastakam| atha(dha)maṃ pañcahastaṃ syāt maṇḍapaṃ trividhaṃ matam|| ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyukta(ktaṃ) dvādaśastambhameva vā| diśaṃ(*) ca vidiśaṃ caiva niśchidraṃ kārayet budhaḥ||(*)(8th line) caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitam| sthalaṃ tālasamutsedhamathavāpi ṣaḍaṅgulam|| darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya (*)puṣpamālābhiśobhitam|(*) (9th line) vitānairūrdhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṅkṛtam|| tattribhāgaikabhāgena vedimadhye prakalpayet|
(maṇḍapārthabhūparigrahaḥ) maṇḍapārthaṃ bhūparigrahaḥ (–) (10th line) kathyate| śuddhāmanauṣarāṃ dagdhā śmaśānacaṇḍālaśreṇisamīpavarjitā| uttamāṃ madhyamāṃ vā uktakāle sumuhūrte samacaturaśraṃ samīkṛtya sūtraṃ (74a, 1st line) śaṅkuṃ saṃsthāpya trihastamātraṃ khātvā mṛdaṃ bahirnikṣipya keśāstikaṇṭakabhasma(...)ra tuṣādikamuddhṛtya pañcagavyena gandhatoyena śivamantreṇa saṃsicya śilo(...)laiḥ śuddhaḥ (2nd line) sikatābhiśca avaṭamāpūrya snātairdhautavastradharaiḥ puruṣaiḥ palāśaśākhasahitamudgaraiḥ kuṭṭanairdarpamodarasaṃkāśāṃ bhūmiṃ kṛtvā pāṣāṇaiḥ (3rd line) pakṣeṣṭakābhiḥ śuddhadārubhirvā maṇḍapaṃ kārayet| athavā ramye mandire pañcahastādivistāram| sthaṇḍilaṃ sūtrapātena caturaśraṃ kṛtvā dvāracatuṣṭayaṃ prakalpya punaḥ (4th line) sūtrapātena navadhā vibhajya tanmadhye tribhāgena vidikāmupavedikāṃ ca sūtrapātena caturdhā vibhajya vedikā kuṇḍamadhye ekāṃśaṃ tyaktvā vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇakuṇḍaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ vā (5th line) kalpayet|
|| atha kuṇḍalakṣaṇam || navahastasaptahastapañcahastayuktamaṇḍapeṣu yathākramaṃ hastāramuṣṭyā ratnikrameṇa kuṇḍaṃ vedikāyāḥ (6th line) pūrvadigbhāge| taccaturthāṃśaṃ vihāya kuryāt teṣu hastamātrakuṇḍasya catustridvyaṅgularūpamekhalāḥ aratnimātrasya tridvyekāṅgulamekhalā (7th line) muṣṭyaratnimātrasya dvyaṅgulekāṅgulārdhāṅgularūpāḥ mekhalāśca kuryāt| tadupari pippalapatrasadṛśaṃ gajoṣṭhasadṛśaṃ vā yonyākāraṃ vā kuryāt| (8th line) kuṇḍamadhye vajreṇābjena vā lāñchanaṃ kuryāt| daśavidhakuṇḍāni lakṣaṇapūrvakamuttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ| sthaṇḍilapakṣe hastamātramaratnimātraṃ muṣya ratnimātraṃ vā (9th line) caturaṅgulonnataṃ samacaturaśraṃ śuddhābhiḥ śodhayitābhiḥ sikatābhiḥ kuryāt| evaṃ maṇḍapādikaṃ vibhūṣya bhaktivairāgyasampannasya śiṣyasya samayādidīkṣāṃ vidadhyāt| atra kramaḥ|
||maṇḍapapūjāvidhiḥ|| ā(10th line) hnikadvayanirvartya maṇḍape indrāgnyādibhyamadhye sūryabimbastaśivaṃ nityavadabhyarcyācamya nyāsaṃ kṛtvā sāmānyārghyajalena huṃphaḍantāstreṇa (74b, 1st line) pūrvadakṣiṇapaścimottaradvārāṇi saṃprokṣya hāṃ śāntikalādvārāya namaḥ| hāṃ vidyākalādvārāya namaḥ| hāṃ nivṛttikalādvārāya namaḥ| hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalādvārāya namaḥ| iti pūrvādidvārā(2nd line) ṇi kalaśeṣu sthaṇḍileṣu vā pūjayet| tadanu| gaṇeśaṃ bhāratiṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvadvārordhvagān yajet| mantrāstu (-) hāṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ| hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| pūrvadakṣiṇapaścimottareṣu| (3rd line) nandīśaṃ mahākāḻaṃ bhṛṅgīśaṃ vināyakam| vṛṣabhaṃ kārtikeyaṃ gaurīśaṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ krameṇa dvau dvau kalaśaisthaṇḍile vā yajet| mantrāstu hāṃ nandīśvarāya namaḥ| ityādaya| evaṃ (4th line)
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sarvānetānabhyarcya bhavadbhiryajñasaṃrakṣakatvena sthātavyamāhitādarairiti vijñāpya pūrvayāmyottaradvārāṇi huṃphaḍantāstreṇā(ṇa) pidhāya paścimadvāre (5th line) nityavat dvārapālānabhyarcya divyāntarikṣabhaumānvighnān nissārya abhyantaraṃ praviśya astramudumbare rikṣāyai saṃpūjya avalokitayā (6th line) gopakaraṇadravyajātavrataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ gatvā naiṛte hāṃ vāstoṣpataye brahmaṇe namaḥ| iti saṃpūjya astraprākārakavacāvakuṇṭhanābhyāṃ yāgagṛhaṃ saṃrakṣya (7th line) vedikādakṣiṇe saumyāsyaḥ samupaviśya bhūtaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā varṇapadamantratatvabhuvanakalāṣaḍadhvanyāsāni krameṇa vidhāya hṛnnābhibinduṣu yajanahavanadhyānāni nighāya (8th line) viśeṣārghyaṃ prasādhya ātmapūjāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣārghyajalena huṃphaḍantāstreṇa dravyāṇi saṃprokṣya svamastake śivahastaṃ vinyasya śivohamiti bhāvayet| tataḥ tālatrayādinā (9th line) saṃrakṣya pādyācamanamāvāhanavisarjanayoḥ nirodhārghyaṃ paśuprokṣaṇe saṃhitayābhimantritapaśvarghyaṃ sthāpayet| tataḥ lājacandanasiddhārthabhasmadūrvākṣatakuśapuṣpāṇi (10th line) huṃphaḍantāstreṇa saptadhābhimantrya pañcagavyapañcāmṛtādikaṃ sthāpayet| tadanu (75a, 1st line) ṣaṭtriṃśadarbhanirmitaṃ veṇikārūpaṃ jñānāsiṃ huṃphaḍantāstreṇa saptavāramabhimantrayet| niravāṇadīkṣāviṣaye bhrūṃ hauṃ śaktaye namaḥ| iti navaguṇaṃ (...)pa(...)praru (......) (2nd line) huṃ haḥ astrāya namaḥ iti karmanīṃ saptadhābhimantrya śāntyatītādikalāmantraiḥ sitapītakṛṣṇāruṇaharitarajāṃsyabhimantrya śuddhiṃ kuryāt| tadanu jñānāsiṃ kakṣe saṃgṛhya (3rd line) naiṛte uttarāsyaḥ sthitvā arghyapañcagavyābhyāṃ yāgamandiraṃ saṃprokṣya nirīkṣaṇādibhiryāgamandiraṃ saṃskṛtya huṃphaḍantāstreṇa nānāstrarūpān pūrvābhimantritalājādīn(4th line) antarāyadhvaṃ sikatānvikīrya hṛdayena kuśakūrcikayā cikīrṇān lājādīn samūhya vardhanyāsanārthamīśāne vinyaset| tadanu naiṛte akṣatābhirvāstumaṇḍalamālikhya(5th line) tatra vāstoṣpatiṃ sāvaraṇaṃ pūjayet| atha vāstoṣpataye brahmaṇe sāvaraṇāya nama iti kalaśe sthaṇḍile vā saṃpūjya (–) siṃhasthāṃ maṇḍapākārāṃ sarvaratne(*)rmakhālayam|(*) (6th line) pūrayatīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ pūjayet| tadanu śivakumbhamīśāne| (2nd line) śive puryaṣṭakaśarīrātmayojanaṃ na ghaṭate| ata idaṃ rahasyaṃ sāmpradāyikagurumukhena jānīyāt| tataḥ śiṣyakṛtaṃ pāpamagnilakṣaṇairūhayet| tathāgamaḥ| viṣa(śi)ṣṭhā (*)gandhe sa bhūhartā brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ|(*) (3rd line) surāpo guruhantā ca goghnaśca kṛtanāśanaḥ| kṛṣṇe'gnau śavagandhe ca garbhabhartṛvināśanaḥ|| bhramati strīvadhe vahniḥ kampa(*)te hemahartari|(*) (4th line) vadhe sphuṭati bālasya nistejā garbhaghātake|| evamādicihnaiḥ śiṣyakalmaṣaṃ vijñāya| pāpabhakṣaṇadevasya rūpaṃ bhinnāñjanaprabham| (5th line) lelihānaṃ durādharṣaṃ meghanādaṃ sudurjayam|| vivṛtāsyaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ raktavastraṃ trilocanam| raktāmuktajaṭācūḍaṃ sarpamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam|| śūlakāsidharaṃ bhī(*)ṣaṃ varadābhayapāṇinam|(*) (6th line) vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam|| baddhapatmā(dmā)sanāsīnaṃ dhyāyet ghorāghanāśanam| iti pāpabhakṣaṇamūrtiṃ devaṃ (7th line) dhyātvā āvāhyābhyarcya kharsahaṣṭhalavyūmakhaṭpāpabhakṣaṇāya svāhetyanena tatpāpaku(gu)rutvalaghutvānuguṇaṃ śatādhikaṃ juhuyāt| bhāvā(*)hāraviśuddho'yaṃ bījayoniviśuddhimān|(*) (8th line) dvijo bhavatu rudrāṃśaḥ satvaprasādāt sadāśiva| iti vijñāpayet tadanu garbhādhānādisaṃskāraiḥ śiṣyaṃ (9th line) saṃskuryāt| tadyathā (-) yāvantaḥ kecana satvāḥ sarvatatveṣu saṃsthitāḥ| tāvantastu smṛtā bhedā dehasthasya videhinaḥ|| yādṛk rūpaṃ bhavetteṣāṃ nāmāgamo'tra ca ṣāṇmukha| tā(*)vadrūpaṃ śivaṃ vidyāt teṣu deheṣvavasthitam||(*) (10th line) chāyārūpamiva sthūlaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ sūkṣmataraṃ tu tam| niṣkaḻairniṣkaḻātyantaṃ rūpaistamarū(*)pakam||(*) (83b, 1st line) dvijatvāpādanāyātha tathārudrāṃśabhāvane| bījaṃ bhojanasaṃśuddhi garbhādhāne ca puṃskṛtau|| sīmantonnayane caiva jātakarmaṇi nāmni ca| ho(*)mayenmūlamantreṇa pañcabrahmaśataṃ śatam||(*) (2nd line) nāmakaraṇahomānte| pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgamaṇḍale śiṣyahastena puṣpaṃ kṣepayitvā tatpuṣpapatanamaṇḍalamantrānurūpeṇa(3rd line) devāntaṃ nāmaṃ dadyāt| niṣkrāmaṇe tathānnasya prāśane caulakarmaṇi| upanītau vratādeśe godāne snānakarmaṇi|| vivāhe vanavāsitve yatitve nandikeśvara| pañcā(*)śanmūlamantreṇa pratyekaṃ homamācaret||(*) (4th line) sanyāsasaṃskārahomānirvāṇadīkṣānantarameva | gṛhasthāraṇyavisitvaṃ yadi(ti)tvaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ| pūrvavanmūlamantreṇa jahu(*)yāddeśikottamaḥ||(*) (5th line) caturāśramaniṣṭheṣu tattadāśramakāvadhiḥ| saṃskāraṃ kuryādeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na kārayet|| iti tadanu pūrṇāṃ hutvā nāmayā gatvā raudryā (6th line) vāgīśigarbhādātmānamuddhṛtya vāmayā svamātmasthaṃ kṛtvā jyeṣṭhayā samarasīkṛtya raudryāntadvādaśāntaṃ nītvā garbhādhānādisaṃskṛtam| (7th line) sphuratnākāramātmānaṃ vidhivat śiṣyadehe saṃyojyāpyāyanārghyajalabinduṃ śiṣyaśirasi datvā vīgīśīvāgīśvarau saṃpūjya santarpya pūrṇāṃ datvā (8th line)
prāyaścittārthamastreṇāṣṭottaraśataṃ pūrṇāsahitaṃ hutvā siddhāntāntādhyayane śravaṇe śivāgnigurupūjāyāṃ ca yogyā bhavānnityuktvā pūjārthaṃ bāṇaliṅgaṃ datvā (-) na śivaṃ (*)śivaśāstraṃ ca śivāgniṃ ca tathā gurūm|(*) (9th line) nindyāna laṅghayetteṣāṃ chāyāmapi kathañcana|| śivāgnigurupūjā ca kartavyā jīvitāvadhi| ityupadiśet| (10th line) tadanu (–) bālabāliśavṛddhāturakān ca samayāt śodhayet tadyathā (–) hāṃ anantādividyeśvarebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ nandyādigaṇebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ indrādilokapālebhyo (84a, 1st line) nama ityagnau saṃpūjya (–) pratyekamekaikayājyāhutyā santarpya| |(...........)| samayaśuddhyai mūlena śataṃ hutvā pūrṇāṃ datvā| bhagavan na kṣamaścāyaṃ sama(*)yācārapālane|(*) (2nd line) tasmādanena homena tatsarvaṃ tvaṃ kṣamāpaya|| iti vijñāpayet| anyatra ca| vidyeśvaragaṇeśānalokapālāśca sākṣiṇaḥ| kṛtvaivaṃ śodhayet tasya samayāṃ de(*)śikottamaḥ||(*) (3rd line)
(brahmacaryavratam) tadanu naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryavratābhilāṣī cet tasmai vṛttaṃ dadyāt| jaṭānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ bhasmalepanaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu| tripuṇḍrakaṃ jaṭā caikā kṣatriyāditrayasya tu|| iti (4th line) vacanāt ekasamaramupavītam| vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa ekāṃ jaṭāṃ sannahyet| athavā muṇḍanaṃ kuryāt| vedamantreśśikhāṃ sūtraṃ śudro dhāraṇamātrataḥ| vaiparītyakamārthena rā(*)jarāṣṭravināśanam||(*) (5th line) iti| vacanāt| āgamamantreṇa śūdrasyaikasaraṃ proktamiti vacanā| ekasaramupavītam| vrataṃ jaṭopavītāśca bhasmakaupīnayaṣṭayaḥ| kamaṇḍaluvratāṅga(*)tvāt vratametattapasvikaḥ||(*) (6th line) vratāṅgaṣaṭkaṃ sarvaṃ ca yogyameva jaṭādikam| iti vacanāt| daṇḍakaupīnabhasmopavītaśikhāmaṇīn pātre nidhāya sadyairabhimantrya (7th line) svāhāntaśivasaṃhitayā sampātahomaṃ kṛtvā vratāṅgaṃ śivakumbhāya kṣaṇamātraṃ rakṣaṇāya saṃsthāpya bhagavannasmai vrataṃ dāsyāmīti ājñāṃ dehīti vijñāpya (8th line) labdhānujñastasmai pradadyāt| so'pi deśikaṃ praṇamya vratāṅgānyādāya yāvajjīvaṃ vratī bhūyāt| kālaṃ saṃkalpya vā punaḥ| samāpte kalpite kāle yajet sadyo vrateśvaram| kālaṃ (9th line) saṃkalpya vidhinā pūrvavat brahmacaryakam| ante vrateśvaraṃ yāgaṃ kṛtvodvāhaṃ tataścaret| iti vacanāt yāvajjīvaṃ vā dvādaśavarṣaṃ vā saṃkalpya dhārayet| saṃkalpitakāle samāpte sati te (10th line) ī(vrate)śvaraṃ saṃpūjya vivāhaṃ kuryāt|
|| naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryavratakramamāha || acintyaviśvasādākhye (–) dvividhaṃ brahmacaryaṃ hi naiṣṭhikaṃ bhautika(kaṃ)thaṃ(?) tathā| ājanmabrahmacaryaṃ tu yāvadāmaraṇā(*)ntikam||(*) (84b, 1st line) jaṭīmuṇḍīśikhī vātha paupīne tu samekhalaḥ| yajñopavīti daṇḍī ca bhasmoddhūḻitavigrahaḥ|| tripuṇḍrāṅkitadehī ca rudrākṣaiśca vibhūṣitaiḥ| trikālamekakālaṃ vā snā(*)nayukto jitendriyaḥ||(*) (2nd line) satyavādī hyadhaśśāyī kṣamāyukto dṛḍhavrataḥ| gurusuśrūṣaṇāyukto gurvājñāpālane rataḥ|| bhikṣāśī deharakṣārthamekakālaṃ gurorgṛhe| tāmbūla(*)mañjanābhṅge haridrālavaṇaṃ tathā||(*) (3rd line) pādukāṃ makuṭaṃ vāpi gandhamālyāni varjayet| gurosthāne vasennityamanyagehe na cet svapet|| svātantryavādikaṃ hitvā gurosvātantrya(*)saṃyutaḥ|(*) (4th line) puṇyakṣetraṃ ca tīrthaṃ ca dhyānaṃ karmādikaṃ tathā|| sarvaṃ ca gurukāruṇyadarśanaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ| gurvājñayā vihīnaṃ tu tapodānādi niṣphalam|| tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gurvājñā(*)pālanaṃ bhavet|(*) (5th line) naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryaṃ hīti| iti viśeṣadīkṣāvidhiḥ|
|| atha nirvāṇadīkṣocyate || dvedhā nirvāṇadīkṣā syāt laukikī śivadharmiṇī| (6th line) śikhācchedaṃ vinā vat sa jñeyā sālokadharmiṇī|| śikhācchedanasaṃyuktā dīkṣā sā śivadharmiṇī| dīkṣāyā lokadharmiṇyā bhautikā dīkṣayet guruḥ|| dī(*)kṣāṃ pūrvoditāṃ kṛtvā samayādi viśodhinīm|(*) (7th line) layakaurye pare tatve bhogaṃ śuddhādhvani smaret|| naiṣṭhikī dvividhā tathaiva śivadharmiṇyā naiṣṭhikaṃ tu dīkṣayet guruḥ māyāntādhvaviśuddhau tu śuddhe vādhvani bhogadā| saskāmā(*) sā sabījākhyā bhāgānte mokṣadā bhavet|(*) (8th line) niṣkāmasya tu yā dīkṣā vinādhvena karmaṇā aśeṣapāśahantrī sā nirbījā advaitadāyinī| prāgārjitaphalaṃ tatra (*)dagdhabījatvamāpatet||(*) (9th line) ākrāntatamasastasya nirodhyaṃ viṣaśaktivat| ārabdhatanunā tasya bhogāt śivapadaṃ vrajet|| samayaviśeṣadīkṣānantaraṃ yāgeśavisarjite (10th line) nirvāṇadīkṣākāṅkṣiṇaśśiṣyasya punaḥ samayaviśeṣadīkṣe kṛtvā asya pāśatā na bhedenātikaraṇatāya mantratarpaṇadīpane vidadhyāt| yāge (85a, 1st line) tu avisarjite mantratarpaṇadīpane vidhāya śiṣyaḥ śivāntikaṃ gatvā śivamabhyarcya| parīkṣito'yaṃ bhagavan mayā tva(...)śavartinā| utkṛṣṭajātiḥ suciraṃ rudrāṃśaḥ samaye sthitaḥ|| kliṣṭo (*)nirvāṇakāṅkṣī ca bhavaduḥkhārditaḥ śuddhaḥ cittaḥ|(*) (2nd line) tadetasminvimokṣārthamadhitiṣṭhamadhiprabho|| iti vijñāpya śivo'hamiti vibhāvya kuṇḍasya svasya ca dakṣiṇamaṇḍale (3rd line) ṣaḍutthāsane snātamupoṣitaṃ kṛtāñjaliṃ bhautikaṃ pūrvāsyaṃ saṃnyasya tamuttarāsyamūrdhvakāyaṃ vinyasya tasya śirovadanahṛdayaguhyapādeṣu bhautikasya mantripadavarṇabhuvanatatvagarbhaṃ (4th line) śāntyatītādikalānyāsaṃ sa svabījaiḥ kuryāt| sanyastastu pādaguhyahṛdayavidanaśirassu nivṛttādikalānyāsaṃ kuryāt| taduktamanirvāṇottare (–) mantrāḥ padāni varṇaistu vyā(*)ptānīha samantataḥ|(*) (5th line) varṇavyāptāstu bhuvanaistatvai vyāptāni tāni tu|| tatvajātistathā vyāptāḥ kalābhistu kalāstataḥ| śodhanīyā prayatnena antarbhāvaṃ prakalpya ca|| (6th line) iti|
(pāśasūtrabandhanādiḥ) tadanu dvijakanyākṛtaṃ sūtraṃ triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtam| pāśasūtraṃ huṃphaḍantāstreṇa prakṣāḻitaśuṣkaṃ tenaiva mantreṇa pañcagavyena gandhatoyenābhyukṣya (7th line) arghyodakena prokṣya mūlenābhyarcya bhakṣyai bhautikasya śikhāyāṃ hauṃ śaktaye nama iti badhvā tasya pādāṅguṣṭhāntamavalambayet| muktyai sanyasyataḥ pādāṅguṣṭhādiśikhāparyantaṃ(8th line) prasārya hauṃ śaktaye nama iti śikhāyāṃ badhnīyāt| tatastatsūtraṃ sarvaṃ mantraiḥ sakaḻīkṛtya pāśasūtraṃ śiṣyasya pratīkāya rūpaṃ bhāvayet| tathāgamaḥ| cchedyābhedyāśca te pā(*)śāḥ sūtrasthāne tu vigrahe|(*) (9th line) tasmāt sūtramayo deho bhāvanīyastu deśikaiḥ|| iti| tadanu (–) hāṃ kriyāśaktaye nama iti| śiṣyadehe saṃpūjya tāḍanādibhirātmānamārādāya sūtre vinyasyābhyarcya (10th line) nirudhyāgnāvabhyarcya nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāgnāvabhyarcya tarpayet| tatastaddehe hāṃ iḍāyai namaḥ| hāṃ piṅgaḻāyai namaḥ| hāṃ suṣumnāyai namaḥ| iti saṃpūjya (85b, 1st line) nāḍīsandhānaṃ kṛtvā hāṃ iḍāyai huṃphaḍityādimantraistāḍanabhedena praveśaviśeṣānantaraṃ mṛṇālatantunibhāt śiṣyadehāt pūrakasaṃhāriṇyādāya sūtre (2nd line) saṃyojyābhyarcya niruddhāvakuṇṭhyāgnau saṃpūjya ātmānaṃ va(vi)nyasya santarpya tāsu nāḍīṃ hāṃ vāmāyai namaḥ| hīṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ| hūṃ raudryai namaḥ| iti vinyasyābhyarcyāgnau (3rd line) saṃpūjya tarpaṇāya sannidhaye ca pañcapañcāhutīrhutvā punaḥ sūtre nipudhyāvakuṇṭhyatābhiḥ piśaviśleṣaṇādikaṃ vidadhyāt| tathāgamaḥ| tisrasyuḥ śktayaḥ śaṃ(*)bhorvāmājyeṣṭhāraudrīkā|(*) (4th line) śleṣaviśleṣu(ṣo)ddhāre sarvatrāvyāhasaujasaḥ|| iti|
(sūtre śaktinyāsakramaḥ) tadanu śiṣyahṛdayapatme(dme) sūryādimaṇḍalatrayaṃ hṛdayenābhyarcya (5th line) pūrakasaṃhāriṇyāgnisthamātmānaṃ trisūtre vinyasyābhyarcya nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāgnāvapi saṃpūjya nyāsaṃ vinyasya tarpya hauṃ vidyādehāya nama iti saṃpūjya tāḍanādibhirādāya sūtre (6th line) vinyasyārghyādi vidadhyāt|
(sūtre ātmasaṃyojanakramaḥ) tataśśiṣyamarghyāmbunā prokṣya huṃphaḍantāstreṇa saptavāramabhimantrya (.............)hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmatana haḥ uṃphaḍiti śiṣyahṛdayaṃ puṣpeṇa santāḍya anena hastamātmānaṃ vibhāvya tenaiva mantreṇa vibhedaṃ kṛtvā hṛtpadmakośāt (....)calitamātmānaṃ vibhāvya huṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ huṃphaṇṇama iti svadehādrecakena nirgatya tat (7th line) dvāmayā tat pūrake taddhṛdayaṃ praviśya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane haḥ huṃphaḍiti taddhṛdayapatma(dma)kośādātmānaṃ tat kumbhakena jyeṣṭhayā viyojya huṃ hāṃ huṃ ātmane (8th line) namasvāheti vā aṅkuśamudrayākṛṣya raudryā tadrecakena tadvādaśāntaṃ nītvā huṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmānaṃ gṛhṇāmi haḥ huṃphaḍiti saṃgṛhya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane nama (9th line) iti layāntaśaktisthamātmānamādāya svapāmayā svātmasthaṃ kṛtvā kumbhakena samarasīkṛtya jyeṣṭhayā viśleṣyaraudryā recakena hāṃ mūlamantrāgrasthaṃ jvaladagni(10th line) krameṇopamamātmānaṃ hṛdayādigrandhibhedena sva dvādaśāntordhvaśaktyantaṃ nītvā pūrakasaṃhāriṇyā saṃgṛhya tasmāt sṛṣṭyā bhrūmadhyamāninīya piṅgalayā (86a, 1st line) recakena nissārya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti| malādipāśakuṇḍanaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamudbhavamudrayā sūtradeha(haṃ) niyojya ātmānaṃ sūtravyāpakaṃ vibhāvya abhyarcya (2nd line)
nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāgnāvabhyarcya santarpya sannidhānāhutipañcakaṃ dadyāt| tadanu hāṃ vāmāyai namaḥ| hīṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ| hrūṃ raudryai namaḥ| ityagnau saṃpūjya svāhāntena (3rd line) pratyekamāhutipañcakaṃ dadyāt|
(sūtre mālādipāśayojanakramaḥ) tadanu hāṃ malapāśāyabhoktṛtvakāraṇāya namaḥ| kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ hāṃ karmapāśebhyaḥ sukhaduḥkhopabhogakāraṇebhyo namaḥ| sitāsitāya rūpān hāṃ (4th line) māyāpāśāya śarīraviṣayakāraṇāya namaḥ| karpūraṃ hāṃ malapāśādhiṣṭhātryai śaktaye namaḥ| tamorūpāṃ śiṣyādādāya sūtre saṃyojyābhyarcya nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāgnāvabhyarcya (5th line) sannidhānāya malatrayasya pratyekamāhutipañcakaṃ dadyāt| tadanu hāṃ vidyādehāya nama iti| vidyādehaṃ vinyasya hāṃ tirobhāvikā kuṭilāśaktibhyāṃ nama iti śikhāyāmiṣvāsūtre (6th line) saṃyojyābhyarcya nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāvagnāvabhyarcya sannidhānāya pañcāhutīrdadyāt|
(sūtrasthacaitanye śāntyatītakalāyojanakramaḥ) śāntyatītāṃ sūtrasthe caitanye sanniyojayet| tadyathā hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ (7th line) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya nama ityavalokya nādatatvabindutatve sākṣāt śivatatvaśaktyadhiṣṭhitatvena śivatatvaśaktitatvasaṃjñe atra śivatatve anāśritā anāthā anantā| vyomarūpā vyāpinī iti (8th line) śaktikalā bhuvanāni ūrdhvagāminī| rocikāmocikā (–) dīpikā (–) iṇḍiketi nādakalābhuvanāni śivatatve śāntyatītā śāntirvidyāpratiṣṭhāni vṛttiriti bindukalā bhuvanāni (9th line) śaktitatve evaṃ rudraiḥ samānanāmāni pañcadaśa bhuvanāni| a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṛ ḷ ḹ e ai o au aṃ aḥ (–) iti varṇāḥ ṣoḍaśa| ādyoṃkāraḥ padamekam| praṇavādyekādaśīti(10th line) padaṃ pañcakalāsu avāntaraśaivairbhāvanīyam| na ācāryam| hauṃ hoṃ haḥ iti śiveśānāstramantrāḥ| nādahakārau bīje| ku kū śaṅkhinī nāḍyau devadattadhanañjayau (86b, 1st line) mārutau vākśrotrendriye viṣayaḥ śabdaḥ| śabde guṇaḥ| vṛttaṃ maṇḍalam| turyātītāvasthā| sadāśivaḥ| kāraṇeśvaraḥ| etairyuktāṃ śāntyatītakalāṃ vibhāvya hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ (2nd line) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ śaktiśivatatvābhyāṃ namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ anāśritādinivṛtyantaśaktyadhiṣṭhitapañcadaśabhuvanebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ akārādiḥ| (3rd line) akārāntaṣoḍaśavarṇebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ nādasarvātītaturyātītayoṅgārapadāya namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ haḥ śiveśānāstramantrebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ (4th line) hakārabījāya namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ kuhū śaṅkhinī nāḍībhyāṃ namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ devadattadhanañjayavāyubhyāṃ namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ śrotravāgindriyābhyāṃ namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ (5th line) viṣayaśabdāya namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ dhvaniguṇāya namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ vyomamaṇḍalāya sphaṭikākārāya avakāśātmane namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ bindunādaśaktaye sva vartulāyai (6th line) ayutalakṣakoṭiyojanapramāṇāyai namaḥ| hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ sadāśivāya kāraṇāya namaḥ| pratīkhasvarūpā śuklānardhendubindunādakuṭilātmakānabhyarcya (7th line) pūrakasaṃhāriṇyā gṛhītvā cūṭādilalāṭāntasūtre saṃyojyābhyarcya nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāvagnāvabhyarcya sannidhānāya pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt|
(śāntikalāyojanakramaḥ) tadanu hāṃ hyaiṃ (8th line) hāṃ śāntikalāpāśāya nama ityavalokya prathamaṃ sadāśivatatvam athordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyat sarvaiśvaryamayaṃ śubham| sadāśivaṃ paraṃ tatvaṃ anantāsanasaṃsthitaḥ|(10th line) sadāśivabhuvanamekaṃ sadāśivatatve (–) dvitīyamīśvaratatvam| athordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyat vidyeśāvaraṇaṃ punaḥ| dīptapāvakavarṇābhaṃ kiñcidraktaṃ sunirmalam|| āṣṭau sudīptā nirmalāḥ sukṣmāḥ vyāpinīḥ sarvatomukhī || mandonmanī sarvabhūtadamanī balapramathinī balavikaraṇī kalavikaraṇī| kāḻī raudrī jyeṣṭhā (4th line) yāmā iti nava bhuvanāni śuddhavidyātatve vāyumaṇḍalāya kṛṣṇāya ṣaṭbi(ḍbi)ndave ṣaḍaśrāyā lakṣakoṭiyojanapramāṇāya namaḥ| hāṃ hyaiṃ hāṃ īśvarakāraṇāya namaḥ| śyāmaḻānabhyarcya (87b, 1st line) pūrakasaṃhāriṇyādāya mukhādihṛdayāntasūtre pañcāhutīrhutvā paśoryugapat sarvatra āṇavamalaparipākānurūpaṃ bhogādhikāraṃ karomīti vicintya svāhāntaśikhayā pañcāhutirjuhuyāt atra kecit (104a, 1st line) śāntiśāntyatītayoḥ bhogabhāk bhavet| kiṃ karmaṇātra viprendravaryagurvaśuddhakarmānurūpadehādayo bhāvyā iti vadanti| tadasat sarvāgameṣu atrāpi va śuddhādhvanaḥ karma nābhihitam| (2nd line) śuddhādhvavanāsināṃ vijñānakalānāṃ āṇavamalaparipākānurūpeṇaiva tadanu karaṇabhuvanabhogā iti| taduktaṃ pauṣkare (–) na karmabhogavaicitrye kāraṇaṃ śuddha(*)vatmani|(*) (3rd line) malasya paripākayorvicitra| so'tra kāraṇam| yasya prakṛṣṭastat pāko bhogatatve sa bhogakṛt| itarastvīśavidyākhyatatvayorbhogabhāk bhavet|| kiṃ karmaṇā trivi(*)prendrā yatrecchā bhoga iṣyate|(*) (4th line) śivatatvaṃ sadeśākhyaṃ aiśaṃ vidyāhvayaṃ tathā|| śuddhānyetāni tatvāni nadrāṇu nāma mahātmanām| vicitrapuramālābhiḥ khacitāni mahānti ca|| divya(*)strībhirmahāścaryaibhogairduḥkhavivarjitaiḥ|(*) (5th line) tanubhogendrayādyaiśca khacitānyunnatāni ca|| atrāpi kālamukhyāni santitvānyatho yathā| kintu nānyatra śu(*)ddhāni baindavāni dvijottamāḥ||(*) (6th line) karmādi nairapekṣyeṇa malapākānusārataḥ| anugṛhṇāti vijñāna kevalā(.......)nīti|| tataḥ paśoranādisambandhāṇavamalaparipākānurūpaṃ(7th line) yugapat bhogī saṃpādayāmīti vibhāvya svāhāntakavacena pañcāhutīrhutvā pāśo baindavaviśleṣaṃ karomīti vicintya svāhāntamūlena (8th line) pañcāhutīrhutvā daivasamānarūpāṇāṃ srotasāṃ tadārambhakamalāpagamārthaṃ paśoḥ srotāḥ śuddhimācarāmīti vibhāvya svāhāntāstreṇa pratyekaṃ pañca pañcāhutīrhutvā śāntikalāśuddhyarthaṃ kavacenāhutiśataṃ hutvā malasya nirodhaṃ saṃ(sa)mūlena pañca pañcāhutīrhutvā (9th line) adhikāramalatirodhāne nirbījadīkṣāyāṃ mūlena pañca pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt| sūtraṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivaṃ strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ (104b, 1st line) (….)kalāpāśaṃ chinadmi hrūṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaḍiti kartaryā pāśaṃ chindyāt pā(pa)śoḥ pāśamardanaṃ karomītyuktvā hāṃ hyaiṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivaṃ(2nd line) strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ śāntikalāpāśaṃ mardayāmi haṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaḍiti hastābhyāṃ pāśaṃ vimṛjya paśoḥ pāśaṃ vartuḻīkaromītyuktvā hāṃ hyaiṃ hāṃ (3rd line)
tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivaṃ strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ śāntikalāpāśaṃ vartuḻīkaromi huṃ haḥ viśvāya huṃ phaḍiti (...)rā tvāṃ vartuḻīkṛtya pāśāḥ pāśaṃ dahāmītyuktvā ghṛtapūrṇasruvāgre pāśaṃ vinyasya hāṃ hyaiṃ hāṃ (4th line) tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivaṃ strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ śāntikalāpāśaṃ dahāmi huṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaḍiti hutvā dahet| tataḥ pāśān bāṇanivṛttaye huṃphaḍantāstreṇa (5th line) pañcāhutīrhutvā prāyaścittārthaṃ svāhāntāstreṇāṣṭāhutīrjuhuyāt| atha īśvaraṃ kuṇḍe hṛdayena saṃpūjya svāhāntena tena saṃtarpya hāṃ (6th line) īśvaratatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivau strīrūpatatvarūpau (rpya)sadhyahaṅkārau śukau gṛhāṇa svāheti pañcāhutīrhutvā| sandigdhāśeṣapāśasya paśorīśvara(*)tatvayā|(*) (7th line) na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena svādhikāre sadā prabho|| iti vijñāpya īśvaraṃ visṛjet| tataḥ paśoruddhāraṇaṃ karomītyuktvā svāhāntamūlena pañcāhutīrhutvā vāmāyā (8th line) gatvā jyeṣṭhāyātmānaṃ viyojya baindavadehasthaṃ kalaṅkaśaraccandravat sphuradrūpamātmānaṃ raudryā kuṇḍāduddhṛtya svātmasthaṃ kṛtvā pāśasūtre śiṣyacaitanyaṃ vinyasya (9th line) ātmasthairyāya mūlena pañcāhutīrhutvā śiṣyasyāpyāyanāya vauṣaḍantamūlena tacchirasyamṛtabindumayamarghyodakamanāmikayā datvā vāgīśvarī vāgīśvareṇa daśa daśāhutibhiḥ santarpya (10th line) visṛjya pūrṇāṃ dadyāt| tadanu hāṃ hyaiṃ hauṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśābhyāṃ nama iti śuddhāśuddhayorhrasvadīrghoccāreṇa sandhānaṃ kṛtvā tat sthairyāya mūlena (105a, 1st line) pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt| || iti śāntikalāśuddhiḥ ||
|| śāntyatītakalāśuddhiḥ || mandamalaparipākaścet śuddhavidyāditatvatrayamadhye yathocitamātmānaṃ bhogāya saṃsthāpya upari na (2nd line) śodhayet tataḥ śāntyatītakalāpāśaṃ pūrvavat pañcādhvagarbhaṃ vibhāvya hāṃ hauṃ tatvabhuvane varṇapadamantramalabaindavasicivāya strīrūpatatvarūpāya (3rd line) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya nama iti svasthane| sthāvarādyaṇu sadāśivāntasayādigarbhamavalokya hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivāya strīrūpatatvarūpāya (4th line) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ huṃ phaḍiti sva sthāne tāḍanaṃ bhedanaṃ ca kṛtvā hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavāya strīrūpatatvarūpāya śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ huṃ (5th line) phaḍiti viśleṣaṃ kṛtvā hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavāya sacivāya strīrūpatatvarūpāya śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ huṃ (6th line) phaḍiti viśleśaṃ kṛtvā hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivāya strīrūpatatvarūpāya śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ huṃ phaṭ (7th line) svāheti pūrakāṅkuśamudrayā pāśākarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā hāṃ hauṃ tatvabhuvanamantramalabaindavasacivāya strīrūpatatvarūpāya śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ huṃ (8th line) phaḍiti pūrakasaṃhāriṇyā brahmarandhrādadhastāt śāntyatītakalāpāśaṃ saṃgṛhya hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivāya strīrūpatatvarūpāya (9th line) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya nama iti recakodbhavamudrayā kuṇḍe vinyasyābhyarcya svāhāntenānena mantreṇārghyaṃ datvā sannidhānāya pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt| tadanu hāṃ sadāśivāya nama (10th line) iti kuṇḍe samāvāhya saṃpūjya svāhāntena tena pañcāhutīrhutvā| sadāśivādhikau rete mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyaham| asya tvayānukūlena bhavitavyaṃ kṛpāvatā|| ityājñāṃ prārthya sadāśivaṃ (105b, 1st line) visṛjya hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivāyai śāntyatītakalāpāśavyāpikāyai vāgīśvaryai nama iti| vaktavastramṛtamatīṃ vīgīśvarīṃ (2nd line) vinyasyābhyarcya svāhāntenānena mantreṇa santarpya yonimudrāṃ pradarśya hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivāya śāntyatītakalāpāśavyāpakāya (3rd line)
vāgīśvarāya nama iti daśabhujaṃ pañcavaktramatiniśśeṣayonikṣobhakaṃ vāgīśvaraṃ kuṇḍe samāvāhya saṃpūjāya svāhāntenānena mantreṇa santarpya vāgīśvarīṃ (4th line) yugapadanekayonijanmaprasavitrīṃ vicintya tayoḥ saṃyogaṃ ca vibhāvya hāṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaḍiti śāntyatītasthaṃ paśucaitanyaṃ nārācamudrayā puṣpeṇa santāḍya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ (5th line) phaṭ svāheti pañcāhutīrhutvā hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaḍiti vibhidya hāṃ haṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaṭ svāheti pañcāhutīrhutvā hāṃ haṃ namaḥ hāṃ (6th line) vāmāyai nama iti kuṇḍe vinyasyābhyarcya huṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ namaḥ hāṃ vāmāyai svāheti pañcāhutīrhutvā huṃ namaḥ iti vāmayā recakena gatvā hāṃ haḥ huṃ phaṭ hiṃ (7th line) jyeṣṭhāyai nama iti guṇḍe vinyasya hāṃ haḥ huṃ phaṭ hiṃ jyeṣṭhāyai svāheti pañcāhutīrhutvā sūtrasthaṃ paśucaitanyaṃ jyeṣṭhāyā viyojya haṃ huṃ namaḥ (8th line) hrūṃ raudryai nama iti kuṇḍe vinyasyābhyarcya hāṃ hrūṃ namaḥ| hrūṃ raudryai svāheti pañcāhutīrhutvā raudryā vijñānāndakośasahitamātmānamutkṛṣya (9th line) tadvādaśāntaṃ nītvā hrūṃ hāṃ hāṃ huṃ paśucaitanyaṃ gṛhṇāmi haḥ huṃ phaḍiti tacca caitanyaṃ gṛhītvā pūrakasaṃhāriṇyādāya svātmasthaṃ kṛtvā sva dvādaśāntaṃ nītvā tasmādādāya tasmādādau (10th line) kuṇḍe vātha mi(i)ṣṭvā tadāśritaṃ vibhāvya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātman śāntyatītakalābhuvaneṣu malaparipākānurūpeṇa śeṣayoniṣu gandhādhānāya yukto bhavana iti (106a, 1st line) anekayonirūpiṇyāṃ bhuvanavāgīśvaryāṃ yugapadanekayonibhedaṃ na bhinnāyāṃ nānākārotpattisidhyarthaṃ saṃyojya haṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti kuṇḍe (2nd line) saṃpūjyā svāhāntenānena mantreṇa santarpya svāhāntamūlena pañca pañcāhutibhiḥ sānnidhya tarpaṇe kṛtvā tayoḥ saṃyogārthaṃ mūlena pañcāhutīrhutvā (3rd line ) yugapadyogamaṇorasya vidhīyatāmiti prārthayet tataḥ paśoranekayoniṣu ekakāle garbhādhānaḥ karomīti vicinna(....) svāhāntahṛdayena pañcāhutīrhutvā sarvayonibhyaḥ (4th line) paśoryugapat jananamiti vibhāvya svāhāntaśirasā pañcāhutīrhutvā paśoryugapat sarvatrādhikāraṃ karomīti| vicintya svāhāntaśikhayā pañcāhutīrhutvā (5th line) paśoranādisaṃbandhamalaparipākānulūpeṇa yugapat bhogaṃ sampādayāmīti vibhāvya svāhāntakavacena pañcāhutīrhutvā paśorbaindavaviśleṣakaṃ karomīti vicintya (6th line) svāhāntamūlena pañcāhutīrhutvā baindavasamānarūpāṇāṃ srotasāṃ tadārambhakaśarīrādyapagamārthaṃ paśo srotaḥ śuddhimācarāmīti vibhāvya (7th line) svāhāntāstreṇa pratyekaṃ pañca pañcāhutīrhutvā tatvaśuddhau svāhāntahṛdayena pañcāhutīrhutvā vaśaniṣkamyarthaṃ svāhāntamūlena śatāhutīrhutvā asthānino malasya (8th line) nirodhaṃ saṃpādayāmītyuktvā śivena pañcāhutīrhutvā śiṣyasyādhikāramalanivṛttaye mūlena pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt| tataḥ sūtratarjanyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ gṛhītvā paśoḥ (9th line) pāśasūtrasañcālanena paśaviśleṣaṃ saṃpādayāmīti vicintya huṃ phaḍantāstreṇa pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt| tataḥ kartarīmastreṇa saptadhābhimantrya hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ (10th line) tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivaṃ strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśaṃ chinadmi| hrūṃ haḥ| astrāya huṃ phaḍiti kartaryā pāśaṃ chidyāt paśoḥ pāśaṃ mardanaṃ karomītyaktavāhāṃ (106b, 1st line) hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivaṃ strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśaṃ mardayāmi huṃ haḥ| astrāya huṃ phaḍiti hastābhyām| pāśaṃ vimṛjya paśoḥ(2nd line) pāśaṃ vartuḻīkaromītyuktvā hāṃ hauṃ hauṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavasacivaṃ strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśaṃ vartuḻīkaromi huṃ haḥ (3rd line) astrāya huṃ phaḍiti karābhyāṃ pāśaṃ vartuḻīkṛtya paśoḥ pādaṃ dahāmītyuktvā ghṛtapūrṇasruvāgre pāśaṃ vinyasya hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ tatvabhuvanavarṇapadamantramalabaindavi sacivaṃ (4th line) strīrūpatatvarūpaṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśaṃ dahāmī hrūṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaḍiti bhuktvā dahet| tataḥ malodbaṇanivṛttaye huṃ phaḍantāstreṇa pañcāhutīrhutvā prāyaścittārthaṃ (5th line) svāhāntāstreṇāṣṭāhutīrjuhuyāt| tataḥ sadāśivaṃ kuṇḍe hṛdayena saṃpūjya svāhāntena tena santarpya hāṃ sadāśivatatvabhuvanavarmapadamantramalabaindavasacivau (6th line) strīrūpatatvarūpau mano binduśuṣkau gṛhāṇa svāheti pañcāhutīrhutvā (7 thline) adhikāraṃ samarpayet| niśśeṣadagdhapāśasya śiśorasya sadāśiva| baddhāyana(*)stvayāstheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti|(*) (8th line) tatasvāhāntamūlenāhutiśataṃ hutvā pūrṇāṃ datvā hṛdayena sadāśivaṃ visṛjet| tataḥ paśoruddhāraṃ karomītyuktvā mūlena (9th line) pañcāhutīrhutvā vāmayā gatvā jyeṣṭhayā viyojya raudryākuṇḍyāduddhṛtya nirmalojvalat saṃpūrṇaśaraccandrasadṛśaprakāśaṃ sārvajñā ṣāṭgu(ḍgu)ṇyābhivyaktiyogyamātmāna(naṃ) dhyāyan (10th line) svātmasthaṃ kṛtvā hautidīkṣayā sthūlasūkṣmaliṅgaśarīrebhyaḥ uddhṛtamapi prārabdhakarmaśeṣabhogārthaṃ kṣurimapākakriyāmyadravyasaṃsargeṇa dadhi kṛtvā tadunmarthya (107a, 1st line) tasmāt navanītamuddhṛtya punastattakre nyastamiva śiṣyasya hṛdayakamale vinyaset naiṣṭhikadīkṣāyāṃ sūtradehe śikhāsthāne yojayet| tataḥ ātmasthairyāya mūlena (2nd line) pañcāhutīrhutvā śiṣyasyāpyāyanāya vauṣaḍantamūlena tacchirasya mṛtabindumayamarghyodakanāmikayā datvā vāgīśvarī vāgīśvarau daśadaśāhutīḥ santarpya| coditau śiṣyadī(*)kṣāyāṃ yanmayā pitarau yuvām|(*) (3rd line) kāruṇyāt tat kṣamitvāmī(mi)me vrajataṃ sthānamātmānaḥ|| iti vijñāpya visṛjya pūrṇāṃ dadyāt hāṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāśikhāśaktibhyāṃ nama iti (4th line) śāntyatītakalāśuddhiśaktau vilokya hrasvadīrghoccāreṇa santānaṃ kṛtvā tat sthairyāya mūlena pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt| || śāntyatītakalāśuddhiḥ ||
|| śikhācchedavidhiḥ || tadanu (-) vakṣyamāṇavidhānena(5th line) lokadharmasthitaṃ bhautikaṃ śiṣyaṃ yojayet| tataḥ śivadharmasthitasya naiṣṭhakaśiṣyasya śikhāmadhvāntasthāṃ sarvādhvavyāpikāṃ malasahakāriṇīṃ (6th line) vāmaśaktisvarūpāṃ vibhāvya haṃ haḥ| astrāya huṃ phaḍiti mantreṇa kartarīṃ saptavāraṃ japet| abhimantrayet| tathāgamaḥ| kartarīṃ jñānaśaktisyādyathā pāśaṃ chinatyasau| sā (*)kalā paramā sūkṣmā mantrāṇāṃ bodhanī parā||(*) (7th line) kartarī kartṛrūpeṇa jñātavyā deśikottamairiti| tadanu (–) huṃ hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ hrūṃ tirobhāvikāṃ (8th line) kuṭilāśakti(….)haḥ huṃ phaḍiti tena mantreṇa kartaryāṃ śikhāṃ chitvā (....)gomayena vedikāṃ śivā(................)haṃ hāṃ hauṃ (................)kalāśakti hoṃ haḥ huṃ phaṭ svāheti śikhāṃ hutvā huṃ phaḍantāstreṇa pañcāhutibhiḥ saṃskuryāt tadanu (–) śiṣyaḥ jale avagāhya samācamya nirmalo bhavet| || iti (9th line) śikhācchedavidhiḥ||

acintyaviśvasādākhye (–) dhānyarāśiṣu kumbhāṃśca prathamaṃ śivakumbham| vardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu vinyaset śaktimantritām|| vidyeśānāṃ ca kalaśān (*)tasya bāhye tu vinyaset| (*) (9th line) saha devyaikapatraṃ tu bhadraṃ vaikaṅkataṃ tathā|| viṣṇukrāntiṃ ca pañcaite pañcauṣadhamiti smṛtam| candanāgarukarpūrahiriberaṃ māṃsireva ca|| kuṅku(*)mośirakandaṃ ca jatujātisamanvitam|(*) (10th line) pañcaratnauṣadhairyuktān śālitaṇḍulakairyutān|| śuddhatoyena saṃpūrṇān cūtapallavaśobhitān| teṣu kṣāro dadhikṣīraudabdhighṛtasā(*)garam|| (116a, 1st line) ikṣumadhvāmbuśuddhāmbugarbhodānaṣṭa sāgarān| madhye śivasamudrasya vardhanyāṃ śaktisāgaram|| krameṇāvāhya saṃpūjyāṣṭavidyeśvarānapi| vidhivat pūjaye(*)t sarvaṃ mūlamantrāṣṭavārayuk||(*) (2nd line) nivṛtyādikalābhistu kumbhaiḥ pañcabhireva ca| athavā ekakumbhena tāmrakenābhiṣecayet|| pañcakumbheṣu vidyeśān dvau dvau kumbheṣu (*)vinyaset|(*) (3rd line) samudrāṇāṃ dvayaṃ cāpi tadvadeva tu vinyaset|| madhye tu śivakumbhasya śivāmbodhiṃ tathaiva ca| tatpārśve ca vardhanīṃ cāpi śaktyambodhisamanvitām|| śivaṃ śaktiṃ ca vidyeśānekakumbhe tu vinyaset| samudrāṇāṃ ca daśakaṃ vinyaset deśikottamaḥ|| atha bhuktyairmadhyapūrvadakṣiṇottarapaścimakumbheṣu śāntyatītakalādīnāmuktyai paśchimottaradakṣiṇapūrvamadhyakumbheṣu (4th line) nivṛtyādikalādīnābhimantrya bhuktyai sṛṣṭyā śivasāgarādi sāgarānantarādi vidyeśānapyāvāhyābhyarcya muktyai kṣā(kṣī)rasāgarādyaṣṭasāgarān| kumbheṣvāvāhya (5th line) saṃpūjya madhyakumbhe śivasāgaramāvāhya saṃpūjya vidyeśānapi kumbheṣvāvāhya saṃpūjya madhyakumbhe sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ śivaṃ nityavat pūjayet| atha (6th line) mūlenāṣṭottaraśatamabhimantrya japaṃ saṃghya(khya)yā pūrṇāntaṃ juhuyāt| athavā uktaprakāreṇa kumbhapañcakaṃ vā ekakumbhaṃ vā saṃsthāpya pūjayet|

phaḍiti puṣpeṇa saṃhṛdi saṃtḍyātmano recakeṇa nirgatya huṃkāreṇa tadvāmanāḍyā pūrakeṇa tasya hṛdaye praviśya (121a, 1st line) tatra haṃsabījasthaṃ caitanyaṃ sañcintya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ huṃ phaḍiti jyeṣṭhāyā viyojya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ svāhetyaṅkuśamudrayā cotkṛṣya tadvādaśāntaṃ (2nd line) nītvā triguṇāgrabindurūpaṃ jīvaṃ saṃcintyātmamantreṇa saṃhāramudrayā saṃgṛhya pūrakeṇa sva hṛdi sanniveśya kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā mūlamantramanusmarannātmantreṇa (3rd line) brahmādikāraṇatyāgakrameṇa dvādaśāntaṃ nītvā saṃgṛhya sṛṣṭyā bhrūmadhyamānīyātmadakṣiṇanāḍyā recakeṇa nissārya tenaiva namontena sūtre saṃyojya (4th line) vyāpakaṃ saṃbhāvyāvakuṇṭhya sannidhāya mūlenāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt| tato malakarma māyāpāśatrayamādāya saṃyojya pāśādhiṣṭhātryai śivaśaktaye nama iti saṃgṛhya (5th line) sūtrasthe saṃyojyābhyarcya sannidhānāhutitrayaṃ datvā hlāṃ nivṛttikalāyai nama iti tatvādigarbhitāṃ nivṛttikalāmavalokya (6th line) hlāṃ nivṛttikalāyai huṃ phaḍiti jānvadhaḥ puṣpeṇa santāḍya saṃhāramudrayā saṃgṛhya hlāṃ nivṛttikalāyai nama iti sūtre nivṛttisthāne (7th line) saṃyojyābhyarcya sannidhānāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt| tataḥ hlīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāyai nama iti tatvādigarbhitāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāmavalokya huṃ phaḍantena nābhyadhaḥ santāḍya gṛhītvā (8th line) namontena sūtre pratiṣṭhākalāsthāne niveśyābhyarcya sannidhānāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt| hrūṃ vidyākalāyai nama iti tatvādigarbhitāṃ vidyākalāmavalokya huṃ phaḍantena gaḻādadhaḥ (9th line) saṃtāḍya saṃgṛhya namontena sūtre tatsthāne nyasyābhyarcya sannidhānāyāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt| hyaiṃ śāntikalāyai nama iti| tatvādigarbhitāṃ śāntikalāmavalokya huṃ (10th line) phaḍantena bhrūmadhyā(dadha)ssantāḍya saṃgṛhya namontena sūtre tatsthāne vinyasya sannidhānāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt| hauṃ śāntyatītakalāyai nama iti| tatvādigarbhitāṃ (121b, 1st line) śāntyatītāmavalokya huṃ phaḍantena brahmarandhrādadhaḥ saṃtāḍya saṃgṛhya namontena śāntyatītasthāne sūtre saṃyojya saṃpūjya sannidhānāhutitrayaṃ juhuyāt| (2nd line) evamavaśiṣṭāṃ bhagavannivṛttikalā pāśaṃ malakarma māyātatvabhuvanādivyāpakaṃ bandha bandha huṃ phaḍiti sūtre grandhiṃ kuryāt| (5th line) tato nābhāvastreṇa santāḍya hlīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāyai namaḥ| ityanena praviśya huṃ phaḍāka(...)yai nama iti praveśagrahaṇa kṛtvā svāhāntena āhutitrayaṃ datvā hauṃ hrūṃ hauṃ bhagavan vidyākalāpāśaṃ malakarmamāyātatvabhuvanādivyāpakaṃ bandhabandha huṃ phaḍiti sūtre grandhiṃ kuryāt| tadanu (-) lalāṭapradeśe puṣpāstreṇa santāḍya hyaiṃ śāntyatītakalāyai nama (7th line) iti| praviśya gṛhītvā svāhāntena tryāhutīrdatvā hauṃ hyaiṃ hauṃ bhagavan śāntikalāpāśaṃ tatvabhuvanādivyāpaka bandha(-)bandha huṃ phaḍiti sūtre granthiṃ kuryāt| tataḥ (8th line) śirasi haḥ huṃ phaḍiti puṣpeṇa santāḍya hauṃ śāntyatītakalākhye nama iti| praveśagrahaṇe vidhāya svāhāntenāhutitrayaṃ datvā hauṃ bhagavan śāntyatītakalāpāśaṃ (9th line) tatvabhuvanādivyāpakaṃ bandhabandha huṃ phaḍiti sūtre grandhiṃ(nthiṃ) vidhāya prāyaścittāya mūlena śatahomaṃ kuryāt| tato'gnāvādhāraśakti saṃpūjyāhutitrayaṃ datvā śiṣyasya (10th line) sūtre dehe jānvadho nivṛttikalāmavalokayet| (nivṛttikalāśuddhiḥ) tadanu (–) hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ pṛthivītatvāya namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ (122a, 1st line) kālāgnyādibhadrakālyanta aṣṭottaraśatabhuvanebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ kṣavarṇāya namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ akārapiṇḍajāgrat gṛhītebhyaḥ (2nd line) oṃkārādibhavabhavāntāṣṭaviṃśapadebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ hṛdayasadyojātamantrābhyāṃ namaḥ| hauṃ hāṃ hlāṃ labījāya namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ gandhaviṣayāya namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ (3rd line) gandhādiśabdādiśabdāntapañcaguṇebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ pṛthivīmaṇḍalāya pītāya vajrāṅkāya caturaśrāya śatakoṭiyojanapramāṇāya namaḥ| hāṃ hlāṃ hāṃ brahmakāraṇāya nama iti (4th line) hemābhānabhyarcya pūrakasaṃhāriṇyādāya jānvādipādāṅguṣṭhāntasūtre saṃyojyābhyarcya nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāgnāvapyabhyarcya sannidhānāya pañcāhutīrjuhuyāt| (5th line)
tataḥ pāśatrayaṃ malakarmādhārarūpam| bhoktṛtvabhogaśarīrādijanakaṃ vibhāvya hāṃ brahmaṇe nama iti brahmāṇamāvāhya saṃpūjyāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpya tasyāṃ (6th line) kalāyāṃ yonirantāḥ saṃkalpya vyāpī(pi)nīṃ vāgīśvarīmāvāhyābhyarcya sannidhāpya vāgīśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya pūrvavat dhyātvāvāhyābhyarcya sannidhānāhutiṃ datvā (7th line) bhagavantaṃ paśoranugrahāya sannidhī bhavatāmiti prokṣya śiṣyamastreṇa saṃprokṣya haḥ huṃ phaḍiti hṛddeśaṃ puṣpeṇa santāḍya recakeṇa tasya deśe huṃkāreṇa (8th line) praviśya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ huṃ phaḍiti jyeṣṭhayā viyojya hāṃ haṃ hāṃ svāhetyaṅguśamudrayā saṃgṛhya pūrakeṇa sva hṛdi sanniveśya kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā mūlamantramanusmaran hāṃ haṃ hāṃ (9th line) ātmane nama iti brahmādikāraṇatyāgakrameṇa dvādaśāntaṃ nītvā saṃgṛhyā(hya) pitroḥ saṃyogaṃ vibhāvya vāmayotbha(dbha)vamudrayā hāṃ haṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti karmānurūpaṃ (10th line) sarvayoniṣvanekavyaktirūpeṇātmane yugapat saṃyogaṃ kṛtvā mūlena saṃpūjyāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpya sarvagarbhaniṣpattaye mūlenāhutitrayaṃ (122b, 1st line) datvā prārthya bhogādhikārārthaṃ sarvaśarīrāṇāṃ yugapadvṛddhiṃ saṃbhāvya sarvayoniśarīreṣu pūrvārjitakarmaṇo bhāgādāyakaṃ (2nd line) bhāvayitvā mūlenāhutitrayaṃ hutvā vijñāpya deśakālaśarīre viṣayabhedena nānārūpaṃ bhoktṛtvaliṅgānātmani sukhaduḥkhavedanātmakaṃ bhogaṃ ca sañcintya (3rd line) mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpayet| atrāvasare mṛtakadīkṣāyāṃ garbhādhānādīn ṣoḍaśasaṃskārān pūrvāśramānanaprekṣya pūrvoktavat jahuyāt| (4th line) bhogyeṣu paramaprītirūpaṃ layamanusandhāya mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpya srotasāṃ śuddhaye mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā māyākāryārambhapravāhaśuddhaye| (5th line) prārthya nivṛttitatvaśuddhau hṛdāhutitrayaṃ kṛtvā niṣkṛtyarthaṃ prāyaścittārthaṃ sahṛdā mūlenāhutiśataṃ hutvā vijñāpya māyeyapāśaviśleṣaṃ saṃbhāvya mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā malatirodhānārthaṃ mūlenāhutiśataṃ hutvā samalādviśeṣaṃ saṃkalpya punarmūlenāhutitrayaṃ juhuyāt nivṛttikalābhuvananiṣṭhakarmaṇo bhāvarūpaṃ viśleṣaṃ saṃbhāvya mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā (6th line)
bhagavannasyātmano nivṛttikalāvyāptamāyāmalakarmarūpasya pāśatrayasya viśleṣaṃ kuru kurviti vijñāpayet| tadanu (–) saptadhāstrajaptayā kartaryā hāṃ (7th line) nivṛttikalāpāśāya haḥ huṃ phaḍiti sasvaraṃ nivṛttikalāpāśaṃ chitvāstreṇa vimṛjya vartuḻīkṛtya ghṛtapūrṇāyāṃ sruci dhṛtvājyasahitaṃ tenaiva mantreṇa (8th line) hutvā dahet| bhagavannasyātmano nivṛttikalāpāśacchedaṃ kurukurviti vijñāpya pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye huṃ phaḍantenāhutipañcakaṃ hutvā prāyaścittārthamastreṇāṣṭāhutīrhutvā(9th line) aśeṣaśarīraṃ vināśe caitanyasyaikatvaṃ saṃbhāvya brahmāṇamāvāhya saṃpūjyāhutitrayaṃ datvā| puryaṣṭakaviśuddhyarthaṃ hāṃ brahman śabdasparśau śuṣkaṃ gṛhāṇa (10th line) svāhetyāhutitrayaṃ datvā| vijñāpayet| bho bho brahman tvayā nāsya dhātuḥ padamanāmayam| pratibandho vidhātavya ityājñāpārameśvarīti| brahmāṇaṃ visṛjya (123a, 1st line) rāhumuktaikadeśacandrabimbasadṛśaṃ nivṛttikalājālanirmuktamātmānaṃ saṃcintya uddhārāya mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpanapūrvaṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti raudryātmānamagneruddhṛtya (2nd line) vāmayā pūrakeṇa rāhumuktaikadeśacandrabimbasadṛśaṃ nivṛttikalāmātmānaṃ sva hṛdayamānīya recakeṇodbhavamudrayā śiṣyasya sūtradehe yujya saṃpūjyāpyāyanāya(3rd line)
vauṣaḍantamūlenārghyajalabinduṃ śirasi datvā sthirīkaraṇāya mūlenāhutiṃ datvā pitarau saṃpūjyāhutitrayeṇa santarpyārghayitvā visṛjya vauṣaḍantamūlena pūrṇāṃ dadyāt| (4th line) || iti nivṛttikalāśuddhiḥ||
(pratiṣṭhākalāśuddhiḥ) tataḥ kālasandhānaṃ vidheyaṃ hlāṃ hāṃ nivṛttipratiṣṭhākalābhyāṃ nama iti saṃpūjyāhutitrayaṃ datvā śuddhamaśuddhe vilīnaṃ saṃbhāvya pratiṣṭhākalāmupasthāpayet| (5th line) tato'gnāvādhāraśaktiṃ vinyasya saṃpūjyāhutitrayaṃ datvā sūtradehe pratiṣṭhākalāsthāne tadvyāptiṃ bhāvayet| hāṃ hlīṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya namaḥ| hāṃ (6th line) hlīṃ hāṃ jalādicittāntatrayoviṃśatitatvebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hlīṃ hāṃ oṃkārānte śrīkaṇṭhāntaṣaṭpañcāśat bhuvanebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hlīṃ hāṃ suṣumnā (7th line) hakārādiakārāntatrayoviṃśati varṇebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hlīṃ hāṃ ukārasusvapnānvitebhyo śarvetyādivyāpinnantadvātriṃśatpadebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hvīṃ hiṃ hvīṃ hāṃ (8th line) śirovāmadevamantrābhyāṃ namaḥ| hāṃ hvīṃ hāṃ vaṃ bījāya namaḥ| hāṃ hvīṃ hāṃ sumanāgāndhārī nāḍībhyāṃ namaḥ| hlāṃ hvīṃ hāṃ samānodānavāyubhyāṃ namaḥ| hāṃ hvīṃ hāṃ pāyujihvendriyābhyāṃ namaḥ| hāṃ hlīṃ hāṃ rasaviṣayāya namaḥ| (9th line) hāṃ hvīṃ hāṃ rasarūpasparśaśabdaguṇebhyo namaḥ| hāṃ hlīṃ hāṃ ammaṇḍalāya śvetāya dravyātmane ardhacandrākārāya sahasrakoṭiyojanapramāṇāya namaḥ| hāṃ hlīṃ hāṃ viṣṇukāraṇāya(10th line) nama iti| śubhrāṇyabhyarcya pūrakasaṃhāriṇyādāya nābhyantajānusūtre saṃyojyābhyarcya nirudhyāvakuṇṭhyāvagnāvabhyarcya sannidhānāya pañcāhutīrjuyuyāt| tadanu (–) pāśatrayaṃ (123b, 1st line) malakarmamāyārūpaṃ bhoktṛtvaśarīrādijanakaṃ vibhāvya hāṃ viṣṇave nama iti| viṣṇumāvāhyābhyarcya sannidhānāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpya tasyāṃ kalāyāmanekarūpayonīḥ (2nd line) saṃkalpya tadvyīpikāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ ca pūrvavadabhyarcya sannidhāpya sannidhaye prārthya śiṣyamastreṇa saṃprokṣya huṃ phaḍantena puṣpeṇa hṛdaye santāḍya taddehe praviśya huṃ (3rd line) phaḍantenātmamantreṇa jyeṣṭhayā viyojya svāhāntenāṅkuśamudrayā cotkṛṣya taddvādaśāntaṃ nītvā śivaṃ sañcintyātmamantreṇa saṃhāramudrayā sva hṛdi sanniveśya kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā (4th line) mūlamantramanusmarannātmamantreṇa brahmādikāraṇatyāgakrameṇa dvādaśāntaṃ nītvā saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇanāḍyā nissārya pitroḥ saṃyogaṃ vibhāvya vāmayotbha(dbha)vamudrayā ātmamantreṇa (5th line)
sarvayoniṣvanekavṛttirūpeṇātmano yugapat saṃyogaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya mūlena sarvagarbhādhānāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpya sarvagarbhaniṣpattaye mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpya sarvagarbhaniṣpattaye mūlenāhutitrayaṃ (6 th line) datvā vijñāpya janatārthaṃ mūlenāhutitrayaṃ vidhāya vijñāpyadhikārārthaṃ mūlenāhutitrayaṃ hutvā tadarthaṃ vijñāpya bhogārthaṃ mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā vijñāpya (7th line) layāhutitrayaṃ mūlena (8th line) vijñāpya srotasāṃ śuddhaye mūlenāhutitrayaṃ datvā| prārthya pratiṣṭhātatvaśuddhau hṛdāhṛtitrayaṃ kuryāt| niṣkṛtyarthaṃ saśirasā mūlenāhutiśataṃ hutvā vijñāpya māyeyapāśādviśeṣaṃ(9th line) saṃbhāvya mūlenāhutitrayaṃ hutvā malatirodhānārthaṃ mūlenāhutiśataṃ hutvā| malādviśleṣaṃ saṃkalpya punarmūlenāhutitrayaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhākalābhuvani(ne)ṣu (10th line) karmaṇo bhāvarūpaṃ viśleṣaṃ saṃbhāvya mūlenāhutitrayaṃ hutvā bhagavannasyātmanoḥ pratiṣṭhākalāvyāptamāyāmalakarma (......) pāśatrayasya (124a, 1st line) viśleṣaṃ kuru kurviti vijñāpya saptadhāstrajaptayā kartaryā hvīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya haḥ huṃ phaḍiti sasvaraṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśaṃ chitvāstreṇa vimṛjya vartuḻīkṛtya (2nd line) ghṛtapūrṇayā sruci vinyasya tenaiva mantreṇa hutvā darvyā bhagavannasyātmanaḥ pratiṣṭhākalāpaśacchedaṃ kuru kurviti vijñāpya pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye huṃ phaḍantāstreṇāhutipañacakaṃ hutvā (3rd line) prāyaścittārthaṃ (a)streṇāṣṭāhutīṃ kṛtvā aśeṣaśarīravināśe caitanya ekatvaṃ vibhāvya viṣṇumāvāṅyābhyarcyāhutitrayaṃ datvā puryaṣṭakaviśuddhyarthaṃ hāṃ viṣṇorasaṃ śuṣkaṃ gṛhāṇa (4th line) svāhetyāhutitrayaṃ datvā| vijñāpayet|

(vidyākalāśuddhiḥ) || tataḥ kalāsandhānam || hvīṃ hrūṃ pratiṣṭhāvidyākalābhyāṃ nama iti (8th line) samabhyarcyāhutitrayaṃ datvā śuddhamaśuddhe līnaṃ saṃbhāvya| vidyākalāmupasthāpayet| hām ādhāraśaktaye nama iti śaktimagnau saṃpūjyāhutitrayaṃ datvā sūtradehe vidyākalāsthāne (9th line) tadvyāptimavalokayet| hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ vidyākalāpāśāya namaḥ| hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ puruṣatvādimāyāntasaptatatvebhyo (dahanādividhiḥ) śavaṃ (9th line) dakṣa(kṣi)ṇamastakaṃ cittāyāmāropya nūtanapaṭena ācchādya sadindhanaiḥ pidhāya kuṇḍamatyajatāgninā prajvālya śiro deśe sthitasarpirmadhupayaḥ pūrṇāṃ sasṛvāṃ sṛcamutkṣipya| tvamagne dakṣiṇaḥ kālaḥ kālainaivopapāditām| gṛhāṇa mantrasaṃpūtāṃśāmenāṃ mahākṛtīti||
pūrṇāṃ datvā ācāryaścet sṛksṛvāvadhomukhau vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ kṣipet| (129a, 1st line) sādhakapautrauśchet citāyāmeva kṣipetām| tataḥ saṃskṛtāyāṃ kuśalāṃśca putraḥ caturo niyojya vardhanīṃ vāmaskande'dhiropya dhārāmavacchinnāṃ parāṅmukhīṃ vimuñcan svatva mujanānuvāteḥ (2nd line) apradakṣiṇamābhrāmya svasthāne'dhomukhītonnikṣipya paścādanavalokayet| jalāśayaṃ gacchet| eṣa vidhiḥ nirvāṇadīkṣāyuktasya tadākāṅkṣate gurusevinaśca mṛtadīkṣāyāṃ ca| tataḥ snātvā tīre kuśānāstīrya (3rd line) trīnnivāpāñjalīn hāṃ śuddhātmannaṃśo bhava svadhā| hāṃ śuddhātman sadāśivo bhava svadhā| hāṃ śuddhādatman śānto bhava svadheti datvā puna(naḥ ) snātvā anugāḥ saṃhitāmaghoraṃ śataṃ skandha dātāro dāhakāśca (4th line) dviguṇaṃ japeyuḥ|
asambandhī śavaṃ dagdhvā skandhaṃ datvāthavā śucau| snātvā rūpī śatadvau vā japtvāplutyeśvaraṃ yajet|| noktamenānugantavyo hīnavarṇo vratonvitaḥ| anugatyāṅgasisnā tvā svajā(*)tīśaṃ śataṃ japet||(*) (5th line) vratasthaḥ vratasthaṃ vā brahmāṇaṃ śivadīkṣitam| vipannaṃ yo vahettasya nākālamaraṇaṃ bhavet|| asahāyamanāthaṃ ca gatāsuṃ śivayoginam| nītvā saṃsnāpayedyastu so'(*)riṣṭairviprayujyate|(*) (6th line)

|| durmaraṇaprāyaścittamāha || atha pramā(*)dataścorasarpavahnihatātmanām|(*) (9th line) hastivyāghranadīvegasaṃgrāmahatajīvinām|| uddhṛtyātmaviyuktānāmanyeṣāmātmapātinām| api dehaṃ dahetpūrvaṃ tūṣṇīmeva śivāgninā|| japtvā (*)lakṣamaghora(......) drudrabaliṃ yathā|(*) (130b, 1st line) raudrabhūmau yajedrudrān kṣetrapālāṃśca tānyajet|| ye rudrā raudrakarmāṇo raudrasthānanivāsinaḥ| kṣetrapālāṃśca ye cānye piśācāḥ dānavā(*)(dayaḥ)||(*) (2nd line) sarve suprītamanasaḥ pratigṛhṇantviṃ balim| ugramṛtyuprabhāvena piśācatvamupāgatam|| vimuñcadhvamiti prārthya balimuṣṭiṃ vinikṣipet| hāṃ (3rd line) rudraraudrakṣetrapālapiśācarākṣasadānavabhūtagrahakūśmāṇḍādibalikāmikebhyo namaḥ| svāheti pūjābalidānādimantraprayogaḥ| snātvācamya samāgatya bhojayeccha tapodhanān| mahāvratadharānaṣṭau yadvā pāśupatādikān|| vastrairda(*)kṣiṇayā caitāṃ toṣayitvā visarjayet|(*) (4th line) darbhaiḥ puttaḻikāṃ kṛtvā taddehapratikāyikām|| patre saṃlikhya tatsaṃjñāṃ gaḻe badhvā vimṛjya ca| śeṣaṃ pūrvavadāpādya yojaye(*)damale pade||(*) (5th line) [iti śrīmadativarṇāśramācāryavarya śaivaparipālakaśivāgrayogiviracitāyāṃ kriyādīpikāyāmantyeṣṭā vidhirnāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ]|

(*)drairlavaṇaiḥ saha||(*) (5th line) ekahastena cāpūrya parahastaikabhāgakam| mṛdā caivaṃ samaṃ kuryāttasmādbhūmau samīkṛtau|| pare pīṭhaṃ susaṃkalpya pare tvekākṛtikramaiḥ| (6th line) mekhalātrayasaṃyukte mṛtpīṭhe vā śilāṃśake|| atha liṅgaṃ tu saṃsthāpya krameṇa khakhanaṃ kuru| gandhapuṣpeṇa dhūpena dīpanaivedyamādikaiḥ|| saṃpūjya vidhivat kuryādrā(*)jarāṣṭrasuvardhanam|(*) (7th line) yadi vā dahanaṃ kuryādrājarāṣṭravināśanam|| iti| suprabhede ca (–) dahanasya vidhiḥ prokto brahmacaryādiṣu triṣu| dahanaṃ tu na kurvīta yatīnāṃ cāvaṭakriyā|| iti (8th line) acintyaviśvasādākhye ca (–) lokāgnimudarāgnau tu samāropaṇataḥ purā| bāhyāgnikāryābhāvācca chādayellavaṇaiḥ saha|| iti
(khananasthānaprāpaṇavidhiḥ) tadyathā (–) tatśi(cchi)ṣyo vā anyaśivabhakto vā bhasmanā snātvā (9th line) samācamya sakaḻīkṛtya śivayogiśarīraṃ prakṣāḻya vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa śivayogikāyaṃ bhasmanā saṃsnāpya kaupīnaṃ parivartya gandhamālādibhiralaṅkṛtya śivabhaktebhyo (10th line) vibhūtiṃ gandhākṣatatāmbūlāni ca dadyāt| tataḥ śuddhāyāṃ śibikāyāṃ pūrvoktavimāne vā śivayogiśarīraṃ saṃsthāpya tulyajātibhirdīkṣitaiḥ śibikādi vāhayitvā (131b, 1st line) śaṅkhakāhalamaṅgalatulyādinirghauṣaiḥ puṣpavājaprakṣepeṇa sārdhaṃ prācīṃ diśamudīcīṃ vā śanairnītvā śuddhadeśe śivayogiśarīraṃ dakṣiṇamastakaṃ saṃsthāpya nadītīre aśvatthamūle (2nd line) devatāyatane goṣṭhe brahmavṛkṣamūle birvamūle vā bhūmiṃ dugdhena saṃprokṣya karadvayavistāraṃ devakaradīrghaṃ catuṣkarādhaḥ khātam avaṭaṃ kuryāt| atha gomayavilepite avaṭe sikatāstaraṇe (3rd line) śuddhadarbhānāstīrya tūṣṇīṃ gandhādinārcayet|
