tatvatrayamīśvarībhiḥ saha vinyasya oṃ hrīṃ (4th lline) kriyāśaktaye namaḥ| iti saṃpūjya niridhya kuṇḍe'pi pūrvavadādhāraśaktiṃ vinyasya tatvatatveśvarī mūrtimūrtīśvarīśca sva mantraṃ saṃhitāṃ ca pūrvavat santarpya (5th line) devīṃ gatvā spṛṣṭvā japtvā sandhāya pūrvavat pratikhaṇḍaṃ kṛtvā sulagne garbhaṃ praviśya pūrvavanmadhyaṃ parīkṣya pīṭhikām oṃ sūṃ kriyāśaktaye namaḥ| iti (6th line) vinyasya tatra ratnādi vinyasya aindrī āgneyītyādimantrairāsanaṃ saṃpūjya tatra gaurīmūrtiṃ śaktyantāṃ sṛṣṭyā vinyasya oṃ srūṃ kriyāśaktaye namaḥ| iti pīṭhe oṃ (7th line) sīṃ jñānaśaktaye namaḥ| iti gaurimūrti mūrtau vinyasya tadvāpikāṃ parāśaktiṃ samāvāhya saṃsthāpyāmukeśīti nāma saṃkalpya saṃpūjayet| mantrā yathā (126b, 1st line) oṃ āṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ| oṃ īṃ kandāya namaḥ| oṃ ūṃ nālāya namaḥ| oṃ ṛṃ dharmāya namaḥ| oṃ ṛṃ jñānāya namaḥ| oṃ ḷṃ vairāgyāya namaḥ| oṃ ḹṃ (2nd line) aiśvaryāya namaḥ| oṃ eṃ adharmāya namaḥ| oṃ aiṃ ajñānāya namaḥ| oṃ oṃ avairāgyāya namaḥ| oṃ auṃ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ| oṃ aṃ adhacchadanāya namaḥ| oṃ aḥ (3rd line) ūrdhvacchadanāya namaḥ| oṃ aṃ padmāya namaḥ| oṃ haṃ kesarebhyo namaḥ| oṃ haṃ karṇikāyai namaḥ| oṃ kṣaṃ puṣkarebhyo namaḥ| oṃ hrāṃ pravaipa namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ jñānyai namaḥ| (4th line) oṃ hrūṃ kriyāyai namaḥ| oṃ hreṃ vāce namaḥ| oṃ hraiṃ vācyai namaḥ| oṃ hauṃ jvālinyai namaḥ| au auṃ vāmāyai namaḥ| oṃ hrūṃ jyeṣṭhāyai (5th line) namaḥ| oṃ hrūṃ raudryai namaḥ| iti nava śaktayaḥ| oṃ gāṃ gauryāsanāya namaḥ| oṃ gauṃ gaurimūrtaye namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ saḥ mahāgaurī rudradayite svāhā| oṃ (6th line) gāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ| oṃ gīṃ śirase svāhā| oṃ gūṃ śikhāyai namaḥ| oṃ gaiṃ kavacāya namaḥ| oṃ gaṃ netrebhyo namaḥ| oṃ gaḥ astrāya namaḥ| oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ (7th line) hrūṃ hraiṃ hraṃ hraḥ iti vā| oṃ skāṃ subhagāyai namaḥ| oṃ sha lalitāyai namaḥ| sruṃ kāminyai namaḥ| oṃ sbhoṃ kāmamālinyai namaḥ| (127a, 1st line(189a)) iti gaurīsakhīnāmevaṃ japāntaṃ pañcopacāreṇa saṃpūjya prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt| caṇḍaṃ vinā yathāpūrvaṃ caturthyādi vidadyāt|
|| saurapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ|| (2nd line) (...)dyāntāsanaśayyāyāṃ kṛtasnānādikaṃ ravim| vinyasettatra tatvānāṃ seśvaratrayamuktavat|| mayāsadeśaśaktyanta kha vātāgnyaṃ bvilā nyaset| sadāśiveśvarau (*)rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇamityapi||(*) (3rd line) oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ sūryāya nama iti jīvanyāsaṃ māyā vidyā sadeśāntaṃ pīṭhe trikhaṇḍakalpanāśaktyā ca sarvato mukhyā saṃsthāpya (4th line) vidhivattataḥ| sathāṇunā vidhivat sūryaṃ śaktyantaṃ sthāpayet guruḥ| sūryamantrā nityoktavat|
|| gaṇapatipratiṣṭhā|| vidyāntāsanaśayyāyāṃ kṛtasnānādikaṃ (*)gaṇam|(*) (5th line) nyastvā tatvatrayaṃ seśaṃ māyā vidyā sadeśagam|| jānukaṇṭhaśirontaṃ tatkhavātāgnyaṃ bvilā nyaset| sadāśiveśvarau rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ (*)brahmāṇamityapi||(*) (6th line) yadvā kṣmāvahniyajamānārkajalavāyvindukhāni ca| āmodaśca pramodaśca sumukho durmukhastathā|| avivenā vighnarājaṃ ca bhakṣyāśī (*)pañcahastakaḥ|(*) (7th line) eteṣṭamūrtipāḥ khyātā mantrānāmākṣarodbhavāḥ|| māyā vidyeśvarāntaṃ ca pīṭhe trikhaṇḍakalpanam|
|| skandapratiṣṭhā || (127b, 1st line) māyāntāsanaśayyāyāṃ kṛtasnānādikaṃ śubham| ātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ ca jānukaṇṭhaśiro'vadhi|| aṇḍadhī śuddhavidyāntaṃ nyastvā mūrtyādipañcake| pūrvavadaṣṭapakṣe tu kṣmādyā (*)vidyeśvarādhipāḥ||(*) (2nd line) ṣaṇmukhaḥ śaktipāṇiśca kārtikeyo guhastathā| skando mayūravāhī syāt senānī ca viśākhakaḥ|| aṇjadhī mohinīprāntaṃ pīṭhe (*)trikhaṇḍakalpanā|(*) (3rd line) kuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍaśramiṣṭaṃ syādīśāne vātha pāvake|| liṅgaṃ purūṇanṛtteśa pramukhānapi mukhyavat| anuktamatra sāmānyasthāpanoditamācaret|| (4th line)
yadvā (–) pratiṣṭhā kārayedvyāptyā sadāśivapadāntagām| pūrvavadvediśayyāyāṃ durgāṃ snānādikāṃ nyaset|| ātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ ca jānukaṇṭhaśiro'vadhi| (5th line) māyā sadeśaśaktyantaṃ vinyaset kṣmādayo yathā|| kṣmāvahniyajamānārkajalavāyvindukhāni ca| tamā mohā kṣayā niṣṭhā mṛtyurmāyā bha(....)parā|| (6th line) pañcāthavā tamā mohā ghorā ratiraparajvarā| tisro'thavā kriyā jñānī cacchāvā adhināyikāḥ|| ātmādi triṣu tatveṣu tīvramūrtiṣu vinyaset| (7th line) māyā vidyā sadeśāntaṃ pīṭhe trikhaṇḍakalpanā|| dakṣiṇāmūrtipratiṣṭhāyām (–) kauśikaḥ kāśyapaścaiva jamadagnirvasiṣṭhakaḥ| saṃsthitā ṛṣaścaite (*)dakṣiṇeśasya dakṣiṇe||(*) (128a, 1st line(190a)) bharadvājastathāgastyo gautamaścātrireva ca| adakṣe dakṣiṇeśasya sthitā ete munīśvarāḥ|| sajaṭāmakuṭādeva cūcukāntā golontakāḥ| (2nd line) tatvāni pūrvavaddeve muniṣvapi yathoditam|| ṛkṣayaḥ pṛthivītatve tatvānāṃ kalpayettrayam| ātmā cāntarātmā ca paramātmādhipā nyaset|| (3rd line) sudehapratiṣṭhāyāṃ jñeyaṃ tatvatrayaṃ punaḥ| tatpīṭhe'pi prakṛtyantaṃ prāgvat prajñāntamaśmani|| tanmātrāṇi ca pradhānaṃ puṃstatvametattrikaṃ hareḥ| (4th line) vāsudevaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaśca trivikramaḥ|| vāmanaśrīdharaścaiva hṛṣīkeśastadantare| tathā dāmodaraśceti mūrtipāḥ kṣmādayoṣṭa ca|| (5th line) pañcapakṣe punaḥ sadyo vāsudevaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ| pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca śrīdharo mūrtayastathā|| lakṣyāṇunā prakṛtyantavyāpikāṃ piṇḍikāṃ nyaset| (6th line) aṇḍabuddhipradhānaṃ tu tritatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam|| aṇḍāhaṅkṛtibuddhyantaṃ pīṭhe trikhaṇḍakalpanā| ardhanārīśvarasyāṇḍabuddhimāyā vyavasthitam|| (7th line) tritatvaṃ kalpayet pīṭhe aṇḍabuddhikalāvadhi| evaṃ harihareśo'pi sthāpanīyo gurūttamaiḥ|| haryardhe pūrvavat jñeyaṃ kriyā mantrā yathāvidhi| (128b, 1st line) kṣetrapāle'ṇḍadhī śuddhavidyāntaṃ tatvakalpanā|| pīṭhe'ntarbuddhimāyāntaṃ kalpayetpūrvavadvidhim| hetukaṃ tripuraghnaśca vahniśca yamajihvakaḥ|| (2nd line) kālaḥ karālikaścaiva ekāṅghribhirityapi| yadvā (–) analaścāgnikeśaśca karālaśca tṛtīyakaḥ| ghaṇṭāravo mahokrodha ṣaṣṭho vai piśitāśanaḥ|| (3rd line) saptamaḥ piṅgalākṣaśca ūrdhvakeśastathāṣṭamaḥ| ete ca mūrtipāścaiva kṣmāgnyāmūrtayasmṛtāḥ|| nandyādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ evaṃ vyāptiṃ prakalpayet| (4th line) trikhaṇḍakalpanā saptamātṝṇāmevameva hi|| brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā| vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍī vīrabhadrakaḥ|| (5th line) vīravighnaṃ ca vighneśaṃ pratimāṃ kalpayet sudhīḥ| yaralavaśaṣasahabījaṃ gaṃ gaṇapasya ca|| māyānalasamāyukto bindunādasamanvitaḥ| (6th line) mantra eṣāmiti prokto dīrghāṇyaṅgāni kalpayet|| ratnanyāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ sarvāsāṃ pīṭha eva vā| brāhmīṃ ca madhyame sthāpya pūrve māheśvarīṃ nyaset|| (7th line) kaumārīṃ paścideśe tu vaiṣṇavī dakṣiṇe nyaset| vārāhī caiva indrāṇīṃ paścime nyaset|| cāmuṇḍīṃ vāyudeśe tu uttare vīrabhadrakam| (129a, 1st line(191a)) gaṇapatiṃ tu caiśānyāṃ sthāpayedathavā yathā|| sthāpayet pratimāṃ tatra vīraṃ paścimato mukham| uttarābhimukhāṃ devīṃ sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ|| (2nd line) pūrvābhimukhamevaṃ tu vighneśaṃ sthāpayettataḥ|
|| bhaktapratiṣṭhā || sāntamādyasvaropetaṃ binduyuktaṃ yathā bhavet| ātmamantrasamākhyāto haṃsaśabdo'tha vāmataḥ|| (3rd line) sāntenaiva ca varṇena brahmāṅgāni prakalpayet| vidyāṅgāni ca vinyasyādākhyādyārṇāstithā manuḥ|| hrīṃkārastrīpratiṣṭhāyāṃ tena brahmāṅgakalpanā| (4th line) ātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ tu tatvatrayamudīritam|| ātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva ca| tatvatrayādhipatvena krimeṇa viniveśayet|| (5th line) strīṇāmapyevamevaṃ syāt kṣmādayo mūrtayo matāḥ| aṣṭau syāḥ pañcapakṣe tu kṣmādayaḥ pañca eva hi|| indrādyā mūrtipāḥ pakṣe nivṛtyādyāstu mūrtipāḥ| (6th line) tattat brahmāṇi vinyasya tattanmūrtīstanau nyaset|| akārādikṣakārāntaṃ seśamūrdhādiṣu kramāt| akāraṃ mūrdhni śrīkaṇṭhaṃ āṃ anantaṃ lalāṭake|| (7th line) iṃ sūkṣmaṃ dakṣaṃ netre tu ī trimūrtiṃ ca vāmataḥ| mahe muṃ dakṣakarṇe vāme yīśvara mūrutau|| ṛṃ bhārarutiṃ dakṣe'nve prā(ghrā)ṇe ṛ matirīśvaram| (129b, 1st line) dakṣagaṇḍe ca ḷṃ sthāṇuṃ vāmagaṇḍe haraṃ carum|| uttaroṣṭhe tu ndhaṇḍīśamemaiṃ bhūmiṃ tathādhare| ūrdhvadante jātamomau dante yo'nugraheśvaram|| (2nd line) kū(tū)raṃ śikhāyāmaṃ astu mahāsenaṃ nyasenmukhe| krodhīśvaraṃ dakṣabāhau caṇḍaṃ kha dakṣakorpare|| pañcāntakaṃ gaṃ dakṣe ca maṇibandhe śivottamam| (3rd line) dakṣapāṇitale ghaṃ ca tat karāgre darudrakau|| kūrmaṃ caṃ vāmabāhāvekanetraṃ chaṃ ca korpare| brahmāṇaṃ karmaṇi bandhe hastānte ndhamajeśvaram|| (4th line) tatkarāgre jñaminduśca someśaṃ aṃ dakṣiṇoruke| lāṃ gaṇuṃ dakṣajānau tu jaṅghāgre ḍaṃ ca dārukam|| ardhanārīśvaraṇḍaṃ ca (*)dakṣapādatale nyaset|(*) (5th line) ṇaṃ pādāgre umākāntaṇḍiṇḍīśantamadhoruke|| ḍiṇḍitthaṃ vāmajānau ca jaṅghāgre triṃcadaṃ nyaset| dha(ya)miśānaṃ (*)pādatale na ma meṣaṃ ca raṇāgrake||(*) (6th line) lohitapaṃ dakṣapārśve phaṃ śikhiṃ vāmapārśvake| bakāraṃ jagajaṇḍaṃ ca pṛṣṭhabhāge tu vinyaset|| bhaṃ dviraṇḍaṃ ca (*)nābhau marmahā kālakaṃ hṛdi|(*) (7th line) tvaci yaṃ vālinaṃ caiva rakte raṃ bhujagaṃ nyaset|| pinākīṃ laṃ ca māṃse ca khaḍgīśaṃ pañca medasi| asthiśaṃ ca (*)bakaṃ nyasya ṣaṃ śvetaṃ majjake nyaset||(*) (130a, 1st line(192a)) se bhṛ śuṃ śuklake caiva lakulīśaṃ ca haṃ hṛdi| tamorūpaṃ tu laṃ liṅge tadakṣe kṣaṃ ca vartakam|| ma ṣa a kha ca (*)kṣāśceti mātṛkāṅgasajātikam|(*) (2nd line) ma a aṃ ka ca i ī kṣaḥ vā mātṛkāṅgāni|| ma hṛdayam| a śiraḥ| aṃ śikhā| ka kavacam| i ī netram| kṣaḥ astram| jīvanyāsaṃ svamantreṇa (3rd line) nyastvāṅgāni ca vinyaset| kramāddhutvā ca pūrṇāntaṃ tatvatatveśvarān prati| mūrtimūrtīśvaropetaṃ pratyekaṃ cāhutitrayam|| viśodhya (*)sthāpayet pīṭhe ratnādinyāsasaṃyute|(*) (4th line) kṛtvā ghorāṇunā homaṃ nicchidrārthaṃ śataṃ yathā||
|| mānuṣapratiṣṭhā|| svanāmādyo'haṃ yukto (*)vā dvitīyo vāpi gṛhyatam|(*) (5th line) saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu prathamasya caturdaśa|| bindunādasamāyuktamānuṣaṃ bījamucyate| bījamucyate| hrasvā brahmāṇi cākhyātā (*)dīrghairaṅgāni kalpayet|(*) (6th line) rākṣasāṃśca piśācāṃśca surān siddhāṃstathaiva ca|| devānāṃ vāhanānyeva sthāpayedevameva tu| kāye tu (*)vinyasettatra pañcaviṃśati tatvakān||(*) (7th line) pratimāmūrdhvadeśe tu nidrākumbhaṃ ca vinyaset| iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tathaiva ca|| (130b, 1st line) gāndhārīha jihvā ca pūṣā caiva yaśasvinī| alaṃ pūṣā kuhuṃ caiva śaṅkhinī daśamī smṛtā|| etāśca nāḍayaścaiva tadrūpe vinyasettataḥ| prāṇopānaḥ (*)samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca||(*) (2nd line) nāgaḥ kūrmo'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ| jānukaṇṭhāvadhā tatvatrayaṃ tatvagocaram|| ātmā cāntarātmā ca (*)paramātmādhipā nyaset|(*) (3rd line) jīvanyāsaṃ ca pūrvoktamanunā kārayedguruḥ|| viśodhya sthāpayetpīṭhe ratnādinyāsasaṃyute|
|| saṃprokṣaṇam || (4th line) vatsaraṃ vatsarārdhaṃ vā pratiṣṭhitaṃ pūjitam| śunakākādibhirliṅgaṃ prāyo vatsyāṃ niṣevitam|| tat pūjyamānaṃ loke'smin mahādoṣasahasrakṛt| (5th line) acastatra sthitasyaiva saṃskāro'tra nigadyate|| pūrvoktavidhinā pūrvaṃ kārayenmaṇḍapādikam| saṃsnāpya pūrvavacchastramanunā mṛttikādibhiḥ|| (6th line) tritatvaṃ vātha mūrtyāditatvatrayapurassaram| pūrvavannyastaliṅgaṃ samālabhya prapūjayet|| pūrvavat pratibhāgaṃ ca hutvā śāntighaṭāmbhasā| (7th line) abhyutthahomasaṅkhyābhirjaptvātha vinivedayet|| pūrṇānte pūrvavat buddhyā śilāratnāni pañcakam| pūrvoktamāsanaṃ nyasya tasya copari pūrvavat|| (131a, 1st line(193a)) mūrtimantrānvitaṃ liṅgaṃ pīṭhamantreṇa pīṭhakam| buddhvā śivaṃ samāropya tadaṅgāni ca vinyaset|| datvārghyaṃ pūrvavat pūjāṃ homaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥ| (2nd line) kuryāccaturthikā karma svamantrasya visarjanam|| iti saṃprokṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭtrimāsādyapūjite| liṅgaśuddhikaraṃ mūlapratimā phaladāyikam|| evaṃ pratiṣṭhā (*)liṅgādiparivārāmarāntikā|(*) (3rd line) sakalānyānapekṣā ca kṛtā śiṣyavibodhikā|| dīkṣāpratiṣṭhayoraṅgalakṣaṇaṃ noktamatra tu| kriyākramavibodhasya (*)paribhāṣā bhavediti||(*) (4th lilne) śrīmannetraśivāryatārakajitā tatpūrvajenāmalaśrīśānādiśivākhyadeśikagaṇādhīśena cānanditaḥ| śrīmat (5th line) ghoraśivākhyadeśikavaraḥ puṇyātmavidyājñaḥ kaḥ sākṣādyaḥ parameśvaro'para iti vakṣinyāṃ rarājoditaḥ| vaidairaṅgayutaiḥ (6th line) susaṃsakṛtamatistadyojanāpaṇḍitendho triḥ śāstravidoṃ varovaravapuṃ nyāyādiśāstrāmbudhiḥ| vākyajñānaviśāradaḥ śivamatavyākhyāgragaṇyo kṛtajñatāṃ (7th line) svātmagurūttameṣu caturdiṣṭā pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ| gotraṃ caturvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ gocarāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ| catvāro gotramunayaḥ sthānaṃ teṣāṃ catuṣṭayam|| (131b, 1st line) ṣaṭtriṃśat bhrātarasteṣāṃ munayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ| maṭhāḥ pañcadaśa proktā vṛkṣāścatvāra īritāḥ|| gāyatryākhyā tu sāvitrī bhāratī ca manonmanī| (2nd line) ityākhyātā śivasyo(....)śaktigotrāṇi kecana|| gāyatryāderadhiṣṭheyāḥ śivādyā gocarāstathā| teṣāṃ bhedāstu te jñeyā prājāpatyādayastu ye|| (3rd line) kicidvindanti cicchakterbhedo'dhiṣṭheyabhedataḥ| tadbhedānāṃ hi gotratvaṃ guṇatā mukhyataḥ punaḥ|| gotrāṇi tadadhiṣṭhayāḥ śivādyā eva gocarāḥ| pṛthak bhūtāstu (*)gotrebhyo gocarā iti cenmatam||(*) (4th line) vṛttayastu tadā teṣāṃ gocarā iti gṛhyatām| sādhvetaditi manyante siddhāntajñā gurūttamāḥ|| gocaraṃ kulamutyuktamiti (*)śrīkaraṇakṛteḥ|(*) (5th line) gotrānvayakulādīnāṃ paryāyatvaprasiddhitaḥ|| gotraṃ śivaśikhājyotiḥ sāvitryākhyamiti sthitam| bindunādasthūlabindunādādhiṣṭhātṛkalpitam|| (6th line) śivācchaktestato binduṃ nādādapi caturvidham| kulaṃ jyotirmayaṃ sthānaṃ gurūṇāṃ pañcadhā kvacit|| śālmale śākasaṃjñe puṣkare kuśasaṃjñite| (7th line) kramāt sthitaṃ catuṣkaṃ tu dvīpeṣvanyeṣu
